raw.title: Senior Product Manager
raw.excerpt: Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform.
raw.description:
Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

About the role

    We’re hiring for a Senior Product Manager — a strategic, execution-minded builder who will be a core member of our Product team. This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the VP of Product and partnering closely with the engineering team and cross-functional roles to design and scale the systems and experiences that power our precision mental health care model.

    The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in product management and thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. We're looking for a mission-driven and resourceful self-starter who excels at turning complex problems into clear, scalable solutions. You should be a strong communicator, deeply curious about user needs, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools to build systems and documentation from the ground up. Experience in digital health and early stage startup environments is strongly preferred.

    If you're an experienced product professional with a strong commitment to our mission, we want to hear from you. Join us in paving the way for expanded access to high-quality women's mental healthcare!

What you'll do

  • Own our end-to-end product development process, from user research and scoping to execution, QA, and post-launch measurement and iteration

  • Conduct deep user research with patients, clinicians, referring providers, and internal team members to understand their pain points and needs

  • Develop clear, actionable PRDs and prototypes to define product specs and workflows that meet the needs of cross-functional stakeholders and set clear objectives for the engineering team to execute on

  • Lead product launches, partnering closely with engineering, operations, and clinical leads on training, documentation, and process updates to ensure seamless rollout and adoption of new products and tools

  • Own the tools that run our patient journey, from third-party survey and communication platforms, to EHR templates and the automations tied to scheduling, screening, and care coordination

  • Use AI tools to accelerate your own work and continuously innovate on how we build as a team, from research and documentation to prototyping and design

  • Define and monitor success metrics for core tools and services that we build, including data analysis, dashboard creation, and company-wide impact reporting

  • Partner with our VP of Product and other senior leaders to inform roadmap planning and strategic prioritization

Who you are

  • You are a senior-level individual contributor (IC) with 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally with a significant portion of that time in digital health

  • You have a track record of owning complex, cross-functional products from problem definition to launch

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguous, early-stage environments, and excited to be a part of a small team developing product strategy, process, and tools

  • You’re both empathetic and systems-oriented — equally energized by speaking with users and by designing scalable, backend workflows

  • You actively use AI tools to move faster — you’ve used agentic tools to actually build or prototype, not just ask questions — and you’re excited to continue experimenting with new tools and ways of working

  • You’re adept at configuring complex logic within third-party operational tools — marketing automation, survey and form platforms, our EHR, and beyond

  • You are a strong communicator, writer, and collaborator who brings clarity and structure to fuzzy challenges. You love working cross-functionally with passionate team members of different backgrounds

  • You’re passionate about healthcare, mental health, and/or women’s health, and motivated by impact

Must haves

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 2+ years owning core product areas end-to-end

  • Experience building or scaling tech-enabled services in a fast paced startup environment (strong preference for digital health or consumer product experience)

  • Comfort using AI tools as a core part of how you work, without ever compromising patient privacy, clinical accuracy, and the trust our users place in us

  • Deep empathy for patients, clinicians, and care teams — and a commitment to building with care

Details

  • Full-time; remote

  • The compensation estimate for this position is between $135,000 to $150,000

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive paid time off

  • Competitive parental leave policy

  • One-time stipend to enhance your work from home experience

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401K

  • Bereavement leave, including for miscarriage and pregnancy loss

  • Annual stipend for your choice of wellness benefits

  • Annual professional development stipend

  • Virtual team events

Seven Starling is an equal opportunity employer, passionately committed to equitable hiring and boldly dedicated to diversity in our teams. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniformed service member status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, you might be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Please do not call our public clinical admissions line in regard to this or any other job posting.

We will be accepting applications on a rolling basis and will close this once a candidate has been identified.

raw.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Content Intelligence
raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionArc XP is the AI-powered content platform for media companies.
raw.description:
Job Description

Arc XP is the AI-powered content platform for media companies. Purpose-built for publishers and broadcasters, it is the CMS and content platform that ambitious media organizations across digital media, news publishing, broadcast, and B2B publishing use to create and distribute content, grow and engage their audiences, and monetize through subscriptions and advertising. Fully leveraging AWS, the platform is built on a microservices architecture, and our teams deploy new features and products daily. Arc XP currently powers more than 1,500 sites in 25 countries that reach more than 1.5 billion unique visitors monthly.


This position sits on the Content Intelligence team, which builds and operates the AI systems that power Arc XP. The team owns the Arc Intelligence API, a multi-tenant LLM and vector platform used across Arc products; Ask the News, which provides retrieval-augmented answers over a publisher's own archive; and the intelligence layer behind our personalization and audience products.

These are production systems serving publishers across North America, Europe, Latin America, and APAC. They support a wide range of newsroom, audience, and business workflows, and that breadth shapes how we build: with strong tenant isolation, reliable retrieval, thoughtful controls, and careful attention to cost, performance, and trust at scale.


We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead technical direction across these systems. This is a senior individual contributor role with organizational technical leadership scope. You will define how these systems fit together, write the designs others build against, ship the hardest parts, and ensure the work scales across tenants, content models, languages, and operating requirements.


What Motivates You

  • You're motivated by powering journalism that millions of readers around the world rely on.
  • You develop clear, evidence-informed perspectives on quality and outcomes, and explain the reasoning behind them constructively.
  • You believe a feature isn't finished when it works, but when it is instrumented, observable, and documented well enough for someone else to pick up.
  • You don't wait for direction. You bring ideas forward, flag issues that deserve attention, and give leadership the input they need to make good decisions.
  • You have a bias for elegance, choosing simplification and consolidation over adding more layers of configuration and logic.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments with many moving parts, shifting focus between priorities as the day unfolds.

How You'll Support the Mission


Platform Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end design of Arc's AI platform: model routing, prompt management, vector storage, and agentic runtimes.
  • Lead major architectural changes end to end, including solution design, security review, incremental rollout, and deprecation of what it replaced.
  • Set technical direction that holds across the organization, keeping decisions coherent with the services we depend on.

AI Quality and Evaluation

  • Own and evolve the evaluation infrastructure, keeping shared metrics reliable, relevant, and aligned with evolving quality needs.
  • Lead the safe adoption of new models through staged rollout practices, quality checks, and clear recovery paths.
  • Define and maintain AI guardrails that protect users, tenants, and platform reliability while keeping model capabilities aligned with product needs.

Multi-Tenancy, Security, and Privacy

  • Own the multi-tenancy model and enforce tenant isolation in all new development.
  • Partner with Security to strengthen privacy-by-default practices, with clear standards for data retention, minimization, erasure, and compliance controls.
  • Partner with Security on threat modeling, secure design reviews, and prioritizing vulnerability remediation.

Production Ownership and Delivery

  • Own the release train from customer test environments to production across regions, hotfixes included, without needing someone else to decide when it is safe to ship.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation.
  • Define and track key metrics for system health, customer activity, and business-critical workflows.
  • Partner with operations and customer enablement to streamline customer setup and onboarding.

Technical Leadership and Product Ownership

  • Drive what gets built. Bring ideas forward, shape the roadmap for your product area, and advocate for priorities with product and engineering leadership.
  • Lead mob programming sessions, design reviews, and architecture discussions, using them to raise engineering standards rather than simply approving changes.
  • Mentor and unblock other engineers through hands-on collaboration and design partnership.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years designing, building, and operating backend distributed systems at scale, including significant experience setting technical direction at the senior, staff, or principal level.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and architect across teams, influence technical direction without formal authority, and stay accountable for outcomes that depend on other teams' work.
  • Strong Python experience, including production API development with FastAPI or a close equivalent.
  • Deep AWS experience across core services, including Lambda, ECS, S3, CloudFront, DynamoDB, Bedrock, CodePipeline, and CodeBuild.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code frameworks, including Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems: model routing, retrieval architecture, embedding and chunking strategy, reranking, streaming responses, guardrails, and evaluation harnesses.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, including tenant isolation enforcement, per-tenant configuration, and usage metering.
  • Demonstrated written clarity across design documents, roadmaps, and runbooks — much of this role's leverage is text.

We weigh practical equivalent experience equally and do not require a formal degree.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Production-scale experience with vector embeddings, storage, and retrieval.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration frameworks, such as Temporal.
  • Familiarity with event streaming platforms, such as Kafka.
  • Experience with NoSQL and document databases, such as MongoDB Atlas.
  • Experience implementing observability with Datadog or comparable tooling, including APM, LLM observability, and application security monitoring.
  • Experience evaluating and integrating multiple model providers and hosting options.
  • Strong API and developer-experience craft: OpenAPI discipline, versioning, deprecation paths, backward compatibility, and predictable usage contracts.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code, across prototyping, implementation, testing, and documentation while applying strong engineering judgment.
  • Experience evolving large-scale production systems while maintaining customer continuity across multiple languages or regions.
  • Media, publishing, or newsroom technology background.
  • Experience developing streaming media or rich content delivery workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with multimodal AI tools for media analysis and generation, including video, photo, or audio.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development program

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status

The salary range for this position is:

$144,600 - $241,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

The Post strives to provide its readers with high-quality, trustworthy news and information while constantly innovating. That mission is best served by a diverse, multi-generational workforce with varied life experiences and perspectives. All cultures and backgrounds are welcomed.

At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As a Financial Crimes Compliance Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting the Financial Crimes Compliance program for DraftKings Predictions, helping strengthen regulatory oversight, risk management, and monitoring initiatives within an evolving prediction markets environment. In this role, you'll collaborate cross-functionally with Compliance, Risk, Product, and Analytics teams to identify emerging financial crimes risks, enhance compliance controls, and ensure alignment with internal AML policies and applicable regulatory requirements. You'll also support governance, quality assurance, and program improvement initiatives that help protect our customers and support the continued growth of DraftKings Predictions.

What you’ll do as a Financial Crimes Compliance Specialist, Predictions

  • Serve as a Financial Crimes Compliance subject matter expert, providing guidance and support to Compliance, Risk, and key business partners supporting DraftKings Predictions.
  • Analyze regulatory requirements, industry trends, emerging financial crimes risks, and program effectiveness within prediction markets and trading environments.
  • Advise on development of product features and functionality to manage risk and ensure compliance as effectively possible.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to design and optimize transaction monitoring alerts and controls to improve the detection of potentially suspicious activity.
  • Support internal risk assessments and assist with external audits and regulatory responses to ensure compliance with applicable laws, standards, and internal policies.
  • Act as the point of contact for compliance-related escalations from team members, business partners, stakeholders, and third parties.
  • Stay current with evolving AML regulations, financial crimes typologies, trading-related risks, and industry best practices to support ongoing program improvements.

What you’ll bring

  • Compliance or Risk Management certifications such as CAMS, CIPP, or CRCM, or willingness to obtain recommended certifications is preferred.
  • Experience supporting compliance oversight, risk assessments, market surveillance, transaction monitoring, or quality assurance initiatives.
  • Prior experience in trading, financial markets, prediction markets, brokerage, or other regulated financial services environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex information, identify potential risks, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex compliance requirements and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements and business needs.

Join Our Team

raw.title: PIP Claims Handler
raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. Position Summary:We are seeking an experienced PIP Claims Handler to manage and investigate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims related to automotive accidents.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced PIP Claims Handler to manage and investigate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims related to automotive accidents. This role is heavily focused on reviewing claims for accuracy, identifying inconsistencies, mitigating fraud exposure, and controlling claim costs while ensuring compliance with state regulations and policy requirements.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience handling PIP claims within the auto insurance, legal, healthcare billing, or claims administration space and is highly skilled at scrutinizing medical documentation, billing practices, and treatment timelines.

This position requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and confidence in challenging questionable claims, excessive billing, or unsupported treatment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include, but are not limited to the following):

Key Responsibilities

  • This role primarily handles PIP claims arising in Maryland, with regular exposure to Pennsylvania, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Virginia, and the District of Columbia. Familiarity with the regulatory frameworks in any of these states is strongly preferred; mastery of Maryland PIP is required
  • Review, investigate, and manage PIP claims from initial notice through resolution
  • Analyze medical records, treatment plans, billing submissions, police reports, and supporting documentation
  • Identify billing irregularities, excessive treatment patterns, duplicate charges, inflated claims, or potential fraud indicators
  • Evaluate claim validity and determine exposure based on applicable state PIP regulations and policy guidelines
  • Defend against inaccurate, unsupported, or excessive claims through detailed file review and documentation
  • Coordinate with attorneys, medical providers, adjusters, third-party administrators, and internal stakeholders
  • Negotiate settlements and reductions with providers, attorneys, and claimants when appropriate
  • Monitor claim timelines and ensure all statutory deadlines and compliance requirements are met
  • Prepare detailed claim notes, summaries, and recommendations for leadership or legal review
  • Assist with litigation support and respond to disputes, arbitrations, or audits related to PIP claims
  • Identify trends and recommend process improvements to reduce claim leakage and financial exposure
  • Maintain accurate claim files and documentation within internal systems

Qualifications Required:

  • 3+ years of direct experience handling automotive PIP claims
  • Strong knowledge of PIP regulations, medical billing review, and claims investigation practices
  • Experience defending against questionable or inflated PIP claims
  • Ability to interpret medical records, treatment documentation, and billing codes
  • Experience in identifying fraud indicators, provider abuse, or claim inconsistencies
  • Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining accuracy
  • Proficient in claims management systems and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in rideshare, fleet, rental, or commercial auto claims environments
  • Prior experience working with SIU (Special Investigations Unit) teams
  • Familiarity with state-specific PIP regulations, especially high-volume PIP states
  • Experience working with attorneys and litigation management
  • Insurance adjuster license(s) where applicable

Salary: $65,000 - $70,000 per year; depending on experience

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, skeptical in the right ways, and comfortable challenging unsupported claims or questionable documentation. They should be able to balance thorough investigation with efficient claim handling and understand how to reduce unnecessary claim spend without compromising compliance or professionalism.

raw.description:
Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energyoperations. We’re live across oil and gas and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable abundancefor a growing planet.

The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems,making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation modelbuilt specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.

We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an AI company in the UK. We’re justgetting started.

The Role

Product Manager’s are responsible for product adoption, usage and value-generation. This means deeply understanding users and their technical requirements and owning delivery for a core area of Orbital. This is a customer- and domain-led role: you’ll spend real time with operators in petrochemicals to understand how decisions actually get made today, and translate that understanding into product capabilities and features that change how their plant is run.

This is a product delivery role. You’ll work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, full stack engineers, project managers and account managers to invent new capabilities that change how the energy industry is run.

What You’ll Own

  • Deep understanding of users, their problems, what matters to them and how they make decisions
  • Product strategy and roadmap for your area of Orbital
  • Strong working knowledge of downstream operations and the workflows Orbital needs to fit into
  • Prioritisation decisions, balancing customer feedback against hypotheses of what will best drive impact
  • Requirements, specs, and acceptance criteria
  • Ongoing iteration and testing with engineering and research colleagues
  • Close relationships and feedback loops with customers and users
  • Product, usage and utilisation analytics

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS or deep-tech
  • Experience with physics, chemistry, heavy industry, manufacturing or AI, UI/UX and workflows
  • Direct experience in Oil & Gas or Energy, ideally downstream (refining, petrochemicals)
  • A track record of inventing tech products
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data, and evolving customer needs
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication — able to represent customer needs to a technical audienceand technical trade-offs back to customers

Nice to Haves (You’ll Learn)

  • Experience building AI products – where the product is powered by in-house trained models
  • Experience building agentic workflows and agentic product experiences
  • Exposure to enterprise delivery environments
  • Experience with process control, operations, or reliability engineering software

How We Work

  • Process exists to serve delivery, not the other way around
  • Pragmatism beats dogma; we adapt tools and rituals to reality
  • We value clarity, speed, and ownership over perfect frameworks
  • We iterate on process the same way we iterate on product

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a delivery or operations role tracking sprint mechanics — that’s Product Operations

• Not a Scrum Master

  • Not a passive requirements-taker; this role sets direction
  • Not detached from the field — you’ll spend meaningful time with customers and operations teams

Core Responsibilities

Customer & Domain Expertise

  • Spend regular time with customers — onsite where useful — to learn about their problems and understand their world
  • Represent the voice of the customer inside the company, and the voice of the roadmap to customers
  • Build and maintain deep knowledge of downstream O&G operations and how operators make decisions today

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Translate customer needs into new features, functionality, workflows and capabilities
  • Ensure your area of Orbital is adopted, used and creating value for customers
  • Translate downstream operational challenges — refining constraints, petrochemical process economics, safety and compliance — into a clear, prioritised backlog
  • Make and defend prioritisation calls, balancing near-term customer commitments with platform durability

Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Partner closely with research and engineering leads to scope, spec, and sequence work
  • Daily calibration of where your research and engineering colleagues should be focused on
  • In the details that matter - scoping requirements, testing hypotheses and iterating on the latest release
  • Coordinate with customer-facing project managers so committed timelines reflect real product and engineering capacity

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Communicate roadmap, rationale, and trade-offs clearly to leadership, engineering, and customers
  • Surface risks and scope trade-offs early — no surprises
  • Maintain artefacts such as roadmap documents, release notes, and customer-facing capability overviews

What Success Looks Like

First 60–90 Days

  • You’ve spent meaningful time with downstream customers and can speak fluently to their operational priorities
  • A clear, prioritised roadmap exists for your product area, understood by engineering and leadership
  • You’re the go-to person for “why are we building this” in your area

6–12 Months

  • Your product area ships features, functionality and workflows that measurably move customer-defined metrics — safety, uptime, margin, carbon intensity
  • Customer-facing and internal project managers are aligned on what’s being built and why
  • Your roadmap decisions are trusted by engineering, leadership, and customers alike

Sales Manager - Account Management (Drag Reducing Additives - Remote)

Are you passionate about building strategic customer partnerships while driving business growth and customer success?

Do you enjoy troubleshooting technical issues, delivering value-driven solutions, and collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams to achieve operational excellence?

Partnering with the Best

As a Sales Manager - Account Management, you will be responsible for managing key customer relationships, driving account growth, and ensuring the successful delivery of Drag Reducing Additives (DRA) programs. You will work closely with customers, account representatives, technicians, and cross-functional stakeholders to optimize customer operations, deliver technical solutions, and strengthen long-term strategic partnerships while supporting commercial objectives.

Fueling Your Passion

As a Sales Manager - Account Management, you will leverage your account management, technical sales, and customer relationship expertise to identify growth opportunities, support operational performance, deliver business reviews, and lead customer-focused solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring customer satisfaction, business performance, and long-term account success.

As a Sales Manager - Account Management, you will be responsible for:

  • Building long-term strategic relationships by providing account management support while understanding customer business requirements and identifying sales opportunities.
  • Developing and executing account strategies that support revenue growth, customer retention, and business objectives.
  • Safely managing the day-to-day operations of Drag Reducing Additive (DRA) programs to ensure performance, reliability, and value delivery for customers.
  • Serving as a trusted advisor by understanding customer challenges and delivering value-driven technical and commercial solutions.
  • Applying account management fundamentals to understand customer requirements, support account P&L objectives, and identify business growth opportunities.
  • Identifying, coordinating, and collaborating with internal teams to drive projects, technical sales initiatives, and innovative customer solutions.
  • Managing the day-to-day operations of existing applications and equipment supporting customer accounts.
  • Conducting routine monitoring, analysis, and reporting of treatment program performance to support customer objectives and operational effectiveness.
  • Collecting and interpreting operational and performance data for troubleshooting, business reviews, service reports, customer meetings, and technical presentations.
  • Developing, delivering, and leading business reviews, technical presentations, and commercial discussions with customers, executive leadership, and internal stakeholders.
  • Providing field support and technical guidance related to customer operations, projects, equipment performance, and operational challenges.
  • Supporting equipment repairs, scheduled maintenance activities, and operational reliability initiatives to ensure customer success.
  • Managing chemical inventories, product deliveries, and associated customer site activities.
  • Monitoring account performance and identifying opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, operational effectiveness, and business results.
  • Promoting effective communication and collaboration between customers, field personnel, technical teams, operations teams, and leadership.
  • Following Sales and Service Standards across customer accounts to ensure compliance with company and customer requirements.
  • Supporting account planning, opportunity development, and commercial growth initiatives.
  • Leading and developing team members through coaching, mentoring, performance management, and professional development.
  • Supporting a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Conducting all business activities in accordance with company health, safety, environmental, legal compliance, and ethical standards.

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline preferred.
  • Have experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, Customer Success, or a related commercial role.
  • Have a minimum of 3 years of experience in refining, petrochemical, industrial, midstream, chemical processing, or related industries.
  • Have experience building and managing strategic customer relationships.
  • Have experience leading and developing teams in a customer-facing environment.
  • Have a strong understanding of industrial chemical treatment technologies and sales processes.
  • Have strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Have previous laboratory experience and/or familiarity with analytical methods, data interpretation, and performance evaluations.
  • Have a comprehensive understanding of customer requirements and market conditions.
  • Have experience supporting technical sales activities and delivering customer-focused solutions.
  • Have strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Have the ability to present complex technical content to various levels of internal and external organizations in a clear and concise manner.
  • Have the ability to identify customer needs and translate them into business opportunities.
  • Have strong organizational, planning, and project management capabilities.
  • Have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Have the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multiple functions.
  • Have proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
  • Have the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of customer service.
  • Have a customer-focused mindset with a commitment to operational excellence and business results.
  • Have a demonstrated commitment to safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Have the ability to drive a company vehicle as required to perform job duties.
  • Have a TWIC Card or the ability to obtain a TWIC Card.

Work in a Way That Works for You

This role may require customer visits, account reviews, technical discussions, field support, equipment maintenance coordination, business planning activities, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to support customer success and business growth.


Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM, with flexibility to support customer and business requirements outside normal business hours as needed.


Travel Requirement: Up to 50% travel to support customer projects, business reviews, troubleshooting activities, equipment repairs, field support, and relationship-building initiatives.


Working with Us

Our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and performance-driven environment where leadership, innovation, customer focus, teamwork, and continuous improvement are encouraged and rewarded.


Working for You

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well-being, which may include:

  • Career development and leadership training opportunities
  • Medical and wellness benefits
  • Financial and retirement programs
  • Additional voluntary benefits

This position requires valid work authorization in the country of employment. The employer is unable to sponsor work authorization for this role at any time.

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Manager - Account Management

The Work

ICF is seeking a Directer, Project Management to lead integrated delivery for a modernization effort for the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s (FDIC). The program supports cloud data modernization, enterprise analytics and AI operations within FDIC’s governance and security environment.


You will provide the management structure that connects workstreams, technical teams, FDIC stakeholders, and delivery commitments. You will plan and sequence work, manage backlogs and sprint execution, monitor cost and schedule, control risks and changes, and ensure that work products are complete, traceable, secure, and ready for FDIC review and acceptance.


Job Location: Remote


What You Will Do

  • Lead program planning and execution across concurrent data, cloud, analytics, AI, and operations workstreams; maintain an integrated project plan and coordinate dependencies, milestones, and priorities.
  • Establish sprint plans with epics, backlog items, success criteria, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and sprint demonstrations; sequence work to support approved priorities and release objectives.
  • Manage the product backlog, requirements, code, artifacts, bug fixes, requirements baselines, system features, and business rules through FDIC GitHub Enterprise or approved tools.
  • Manage team and individual project budgets, track actual and projected costs, monitor burn rate, and provide cost projections and timely corrective actions.
  • Prepare weekly status reports covering cost, current and planned activities, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items; provide clear briefings to FDIC stakeholders.
  • Coordinate architecture, infrastructure, data, security, privacy, operations, and business stakeholder reviews; ensure decisions address cost, security, operations, technical standards, and mission requirements.
  • Manage requirements, risk, issue, change, and configuration processes, including FDIC Change Control Board and ServiceNow processes for production changes and configuration items.
  • Ensure deliverables and sprint outcomes meet acceptance criteria; coordinate quality reviews, continuous testing and validation, stakeholder feedback, and resolution of rework before submission.
  • Oversee security and compliance coordination, including A&A and ATO support, NIST 800-53 controls, POA&Ms, Azure policy findings, hardening guides, Security Impact Assessments, and annual security assessments.
  • Lead transition and continuity activities, including knowledge transfer, resource coordination, documentation handoff, communication channels, risk mitigation, and readiness for uninterrupted operations.

What You Will Bring With You:

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex technology programs or projects with multiple technical workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
  • Experience applying Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog management, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and work tracking through GitHub, Jira, or comparable tools.
  • Experience managing budgets, burn rates, schedules, risks, issues, action items, status reporting, and cost or schedule corrective actions.
  • Experience coordinating cloud, data, application, security, infrastructure, or analytics teams and translating technical issues and trade-offs for business and government stakeholders.
  • Experience managing requirements, deliverables, change control, quality assurance, acceptance criteria, and version-controlled project documentation.
  • Ability to satisfy FDIC personnel eligibility and background-investigation requirements
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.
  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

What we would like you to bring:

  • Experience supporting federal or regulated technology modernization programs, particularly cloud, data management, analytics, AI, or enterprise platform initiatives.
  • Experience with Azure, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure AI services, or comparable cloud technologies.
  • Experience supporting FDIC or similar governance bodies, including enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data governance, change control, A&A, ATO, or configuration management processes.
  • Experience developing project, risk, requirements, security, architecture, data, testing, UAT, and transition documentation.
  • Experience using GitHub Enterprise, ServiceNow, Jira, Power BI, Azure Monitor, or comparable delivery and reporting tools.
  • Experience establishing KPIs, agile metrics, quality measures, stakeholder feedback loops, and QASP-style performance reporting.
  • Experience leading transition-in or transition-out activities, incumbent knowledge transfer, operational readiness, or continuity planning.
  • PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, or comparable project or Agile certification.

Professional Skills

  • Lead with clarity and accountability across technical teams, government stakeholders, and partner organizations.
  • Communicate status, risks, decisions, and recommendations concisely to both executive and working-level audiences.
  • Organize complex work into actionable plans with clear ownership, sequencing, and follow-through.

raw.description:
ABOUT UNBOUNDED

We are a team of former classroom teachers, district and school leaders, curriculum writers, and education experts unified by our desire to see every student thrive in school.

Our commitment to every learner unites us. UnboundEd works side-by-side with teachers, coaches, principals, and district leaders to ensure every student has access to grade-level, engaging, affirming, and meaningful — GLEAM™ — instruction. By cultivating the mindsets, knowledge, and skills at the heart of truly transformative teaching and learning, we can break the predictability of historic achievement patterns so all kids thrive.

In 2023, UnboundEd joined forces with Pivot Learning and CORE Learning to expand our offerings and drive long-needed changes in instruction, especially in the highest-need schools.

POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, the Regional Director is a customer-facing role responsible for cultivating new partnerships, strengthening existing relationships, and promoting high-quality program engagements. This position requires occasional travel (up to 40%) to support customer meetings, conferences, and events.

This role is critical in UnboundEd’s sales strategy: qualifying leads, generating opportunities, and advancing them through the sales cycle. The Regional Director is ideal for an educator, consultative sales professional, or customer-focused leader eager to grow as part of a dynamic, mission-driven team. As a Regional Director, your work directly shapes educators' professional learning experiences, ensuring that students—particularly those historically underserved—receive the high-quality instruction they deserve.

This role requires a successful track record of quota attainment exceeding $2 million annually and is critical to UnboundEd’s sales strategy: actively prospecting, qualifying leads, generating pipeline, and closing complex district-level opportunities across the sales cycle.

UnboundEd is a virtual organization, and this exempt position can be based anywhere in the United States. UnboundEd has core business hours, during which we expect all staff to be available from 9 am to 5 pm local time. Candidates from the Southeast or Mid-America regions preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

Partnership Development

  • Develop a territory growth plan that aligns with annual revenue goals and key customer targets.
  • Leverage industry insights, data, and historical sales to identify top prospects and generate new opportunities.
  • Provide strategic consulting to your district partners to assist them in meeting their instructional objectives.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline; design sales strategies tailored to account/territory needs.
  • Accurately track accounts, opportunities, and next steps in the CRM.
  • Use CRM insights to advance opportunities through the sales cycle and close deals.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual and team revenue goals

Client Management

  • Provide strategic advice to district partners to help them achieve their goals.
  • Deliver high-quality interactions that create exceptional customer experiences.
  • Build trust and serve as a valued partner to schools and districts.
  • Develop expertise in all UnboundEd programs to recommend relevant professional learning solutions.
  • Actively listen, assess needs, and propose the best-fit services.
  • Lead customer meetings and strategies that drive engagement and long-term partnerships.
  • Provide consistent follow-up to ensure customer satisfaction and impact.
  • Stay current on industry trends through conferences, research, internal training, and professional learning.

Requirements

Location:

  • Remote (United States). We welcome candidates from across the country with experience building strong relationships with school and district leaders. Candidates from the Southeast or Mid-America regions preferred.

Education:

  • A bachelor’s degree is required (field open); an advanced degree is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will also be considered.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience required; preference for supervisory, sales, or large-scale project leadership background.
  • A successful track record of quota attainment that exceeds $2 million annually.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

  • Commitment to UnboundEd’s organizational values and mission.
  • A learning orientation and dedication to equity and inclusion.
  • Knowledge of urban school environments.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while building strong cross-geography relationships.
  • A collaborative spirit and eagerness to contribute to a highly engaged team.
  • Entrepreneurial drive and adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Zoom, Salesforce, and collaboration tools such as Slack.

Benefits

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

UnboundEd offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience. The annual salary hiring range for this position is $100,000 to $125,000, plus an incentive compensation plan that can bring on-track earnings to $200K-$250K.

UnboundEd bases compensation offers on relevant years of experience, internal equity, and company budgets. Because of our strong commitment to equity and growth, UnboundEd does not negotiate compensation offers.

We also offer a generous benefits package that includes take-as-you-need vacation time, group medical, dental, and vision plans, disability and life insurance plans, and an employer-sponsored 401K retirement plan with a 5% employer contribution and no vesting period.

Beyond pay and benefits, UnboundEd offers a collaborative, mission-driven environment where your work directly impacts educators and students nationwide.

At GDIT you’ll be a meaningful part of improving how GDIT supports federal agencies in achieving their mission. Our continued success on the HOM Program depends on a Senior Oracle eBusiness Suite (EBS) Database Administrator (DBA) joining our team to support our existing DBA team members in performing at the highest levels for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Financial Management Systems Group (FMSG).


The primary application that GDIT supports on the HOM Program is the Healthcare Integrated General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS) which is a very large complex system with approximately 3,000 total users, processing an average of 4.5 million transactional claim records per day which equates to over 1.2 billion annually. There is an average of 46,000 new accounts receivable, and 168,000 payments processed per day along with 20,000 queries/reports run daily. Utilizing Oracle Federal Financials as the base application of HIGLAS, it provides CMS with a uniform financial management system to account for over $1 Trillion in outlays for healthcare each year across multiple lines of business.


In this role you will:

  • Support our mission critical production environments including our validation, test, and development environments.
  • Support mission critical production systems, to include being available as needed for off-hour deployments over nights and weekends; or to support on-call team members.
  • Support Oracle EBS 12.2.x Database 19c RAC and Data Guard Databases along with other applications and databases
  • Automate routine DBA tasks using Python, shell scripts, and Ansible.
  • Work collaboratively with functional teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and external vendors.
  • Provide solutions to improve system performance tuning/optimization.
  • Support capacity planning and forecasting
  • Proactively monitor and quickly address identified application or system issues
  • Clone, patch and upgrade the Oracle DB & eBusiness Suite (EBS)/HIGLAS
  • Backup and restore the database and applications
  • Maintain and support the synchronization of our production and disaster recovery (DR) environments
  • Support migrations of data and code to various environments

What you’ll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology or technical discipline
  • 8+ years’ experience supporting Oracle eBusiness Suite (EBS) applications and environments (installation, configuration, upgrade, patching) in a R12.2.x environment with Database 19c.
  • Deep understanding of Oracle databases, Exadata environments, RAC, Data Guard, and backup/recovery processes.
  • Experience supporting middleware applications including Hyperion/EPM, ECC, BIAPPS/OBIEE, Tableau, SOA, Incorta, and analytics platforms.
  • Experience with managing enterprise identity solutions including Oracle OAM, OID, and OIG is a plus
  • Experience in designing, developing, and testing updates and new enhancements within RDBMS and Oracle DB concepts.
  • Capacity planning and High Availability (HA) configuration with DR setup and configuration experience
  • Ability to diagnose complex production issues under pressure and lead cross‑functional incident response.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience in large‑scale enterprise environments supporting mission‑critical financial or ERP systems.
  • Knowledge and expertise in Shell, Perl scripting and/or Python, Ansible scripting
  • Strong experience of Exadata Engineered Systems
  • Knowledge of Oracle cloud will be a plus

Attributes for Success:

  • Consultative and proactive Mindset for solving problems and presenting solutions to our team and our customers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Being a Team Player, including flexibility to support others when needed

LOCATION: Remote


CLEARANCE:

Ability to obtain a Public Trust: candidate must have lived in the United States at least three (3) out of the last five (5) years and pass a public trust background investigation.

We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. Are you passionate about Internet Security and Customer Advocacy? Do you want to work where the people are as committed and as passionate as you are? As a Technical Account Manager at CrowdStrike you will provide proactive technical support to our Premium Support customers.

raw.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director, Digital & Performance Marketing, you will be tasked with building and scaling an AI-first performance marketing engine that drives pipeline, revenue, and growth efficiency, architecting a self-optimizing digital system that continuously informs where we invest, who we target, and how we convert. This is not a traditional demand gen or media role: you will connect audience, intent, creative, and data into a real-time, signal-driven growth engine that consistently produces a high-quality pipeline and accelerates revenue. This role sits at the center of Revenue Marketing and directly impacts pipeline creation, conversion, and CAC efficiency.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Define and own the digital marketing strategy aligned to pipeline and revenue goals; translate business priorities into clear investment strategies, channel mix, and audience focus; identify market opportunities, whitespace, and growth levers to inform planning; act as a key contributor to annual and quarterly planning, influencing budget allocation and strategic bets.
  • Build and scale a digital-first pipeline generation engine across paid media, intent signals, and account-based engagement; own performance across the funnel, from engagement to pipeline to revenue; architect and optimize a multi-channel engagement strategy spanning SEM, paid social, programmatic display, CTV, audio/podcasts, Reddit, and programmatic OOH, leveraging each channel's strengths to drive coordinated, signal-based engagement across the buyer journey; use AI-driven bidding and budget allocation tools to shift spend across channels in real time, based on performance, intent signals, and account engagement; ensure programs are optimized for pipeline quality, conversion, and velocity, not just lead volume; establish clear linkage between media investment and business outcomes.
  • Translate ICP, personas, and segmentation into actionable target audiences across channels; leverage first-party and third-party intent data, engagement signals, and account insights to prioritize spend; apply AI and predictive modeling to score accounts, surface buying signals, and prioritize outreach before a lead even raises their hand; use a CDP (e.g., Hightouch) to unify first-party data and activate it across paid and owned channels; leverage identity resolution and data collaboration tools (e.g., LiveRamp) to extend audience match rates and connect online and offline signals; partner with Marketing Ops and Data Analytics teams to operationalize signal-driven decision making and continuously refine targeting based on in-market behavior and performance data.
  • Set the AI roadmap for the digital marketing function, including which tools, which use cases, and which workflows get automated first; evaluate and pilot AI platforms for media buying, audience modeling, creative generation, and campaign optimization; build AI-assisted creative testing workflows that generate, test, and iterate ad variants faster than manual processes allow; establish guardrails for responsible AI use in targeting, personalization, and content generation; track where AI is actually moving the needle on CAC, pipeline velocity, and conversion, and kill what is not working; keep the team current on new AI capabilities relevant to performance marketing and push adoption where it drives results.
  • Build and lead a structured experimentation framework across channels, creative, offers, and landing experiences; use performance data and AI-powered analysis to identify drivers of success and areas for optimization; continuously evolve performance benchmarks and redefine what great looks like.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a team of high-performing digital marketers; establish a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement; elevate team capabilities across strategy, execution, AI fluency, and data fluency; set and maintain a high bar for performance, creativity, and impact.
  • Lead cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing Ops, Data Analytics, and Regional/Field Marketing to keep digital strategy aligned with business priorities; partner with Geo Leaders to manage expectations and act as the digital voice in regional business reviews; share regional performance, pipeline creation progress, and digital engagement insights with Geo Leaders on a regular cadence; translate global digital strategy into regional context, and surface regional needs back into the broader strategy.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 10 or more years of experience in B2B digital or performance marketing, with cybersecurity experience a major plus; experience in cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise SaaS is preferred.
  • Proven ability to define and lead marketing strategy, not just execute campaigns, with experience influencing planning cycles, investment decisions, and GTM strategy.
  • Strong understanding of how digital marketing drives pipeline, revenue, and growth efficiency, and a demonstrated track record of driving measurable pipeline impact and ROI.
  • Deep expertise across paid media, audience targeting, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools, such as predictive bidding, AI creative generation, account scoring models, or similar.
  • Strong experience leveraging first-party and third-party intent data, account scoring and segmentation, multi-channel audience orchestration, and AI/ML-driven optimization and automation.
  • Proficiency with modern martech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase), and the ability to translate data into clear insights and actionable strategy.
  • Proven ability to build or transform digital functions into scalable, AI-enabled revenue engines, with strong test-and-learn discipline and a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, with a bias for action and strong ownership and accountability.
  • Player/coach mindset with experience leading and developing teams, strong cross-functional collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Ops, and Analytics, and excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity and drive alignment.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

Work Perks & Flexibility

raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. Position Summary:We are seeking an experienced PIP Claims Handler to manage and investigate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims related to automotive accidents.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced PIP Claims Handler to manage and investigate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims related to automotive accidents. This role is heavily focused on reviewing claims for accuracy, identifying inconsistencies, mitigating fraud exposure, and controlling claim costs while ensuring compliance with state regulations and policy requirements.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience handling PIP claims within the auto insurance, legal, healthcare billing, or claims administration space and is highly skilled at scrutinizing medical documentation, billing practices, and treatment timelines.

This position requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and confidence in challenging questionable claims, excessive billing, or unsupported treatment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include, but are not limited to the following):

Key Responsibilities

  • This role primarily handles PIP claims arising in Maryland, with regular exposure to Pennsylvania, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Virginia, and the District of Columbia. Familiarity with the regulatory frameworks in any of these states is strongly preferred; mastery of Maryland PIP is required
  • Review, investigate, and manage PIP claims from initial notice through resolution
  • Analyze medical records, treatment plans, billing submissions, police reports, and supporting documentation
  • Identify billing irregularities, excessive treatment patterns, duplicate charges, inflated claims, or potential fraud indicators
  • Evaluate claim validity and determine exposure based on applicable state PIP regulations and policy guidelines
  • Defend against inaccurate, unsupported, or excessive claims through detailed file review and documentation
  • Coordinate with attorneys, medical providers, adjusters, third-party administrators, and internal stakeholders
  • Negotiate settlements and reductions with providers, attorneys, and claimants when appropriate
  • Monitor claim timelines and ensure all statutory deadlines and compliance requirements are met
  • Prepare detailed claim notes, summaries, and recommendations for leadership or legal review
  • Assist with litigation support and respond to disputes, arbitrations, or audits related to PIP claims
  • Identify trends and recommend process improvements to reduce claim leakage and financial exposure
  • Maintain accurate claim files and documentation within internal systems

Qualifications Required:

  • 3+ years of direct experience handling automotive PIP claims
  • Strong knowledge of PIP regulations, medical billing review, and claims investigation practices
  • Experience defending against questionable or inflated PIP claims
  • Ability to interpret medical records, treatment documentation, and billing codes
  • Experience in identifying fraud indicators, provider abuse, or claim inconsistencies
  • Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining accuracy
  • Proficient in claims management systems and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in rideshare, fleet, rental, or commercial auto claims environments
  • Prior experience working with SIU (Special Investigations Unit) teams
  • Familiarity with state-specific PIP regulations, especially high-volume PIP states
  • Experience working with attorneys and litigation management
  • Insurance adjuster license(s) where applicable

Salary: $65,000 - $70,000 per year; depending on experience

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, skeptical in the right ways, and comfortable challenging unsupported claims or questionable documentation. title: Senior Product Manager
description: Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energyoperations.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager
raw.excerpt: Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energyoperations.
raw.description:
Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energyoperations. We’re live across oil and gas and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable abundancefor a growing planet.

The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems,making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation modelbuilt specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.

We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an AI company in the UK. We’re justgetting started.

The Role

Product Manager’s are responsible for product adoption, usage and value-generation. This means deeply understanding users and their technical requirements and owning delivery for a core area of Orbital. This is a customer- and domain-led role: you’ll spend real time with operators in petrochemicals to understand how decisions actually get made today, and translate that understanding into product capabilities and features that change how their plant is run.

This is a product delivery role. You’ll work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, full stack engineers, project managers and account managers to invent new capabilities that change how the energy industry is run.

What You’ll Own

  • Deep understanding of users, their problems, what matters to them and how they make decisions
  • Product strategy and roadmap for your area of Orbital
  • Strong working knowledge of downstream operations and the workflows Orbital needs to fit into
  • Prioritisation decisions, balancing customer feedback against hypotheses of what will best drive impact
  • Requirements, specs, and acceptance criteria
  • Ongoing iteration and testing with engineering and research colleagues
  • Close relationships and feedback loops with customers and users
  • Product, usage and utilisation analytics

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS or deep-tech
  • Experience with physics, chemistry, heavy industry, manufacturing or AI, UI/UX and workflows
  • Direct experience in Oil & Gas or Energy, ideally downstream (refining, petrochemicals)
  • A track record of inventing tech products
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, incomplete data, and evolving customer needs
  • Clear, structured written and verbal communication — able to represent customer needs to a technical audienceand technical trade-offs back to customers

Nice to Haves (You’ll Learn)

  • Experience building AI products – where the product is powered by in-house trained models
  • Experience building agentic workflows and agentic product experiences
  • Exposure to enterprise delivery environments
  • Experience with process control, operations, or reliability engineering software

How We Work

  • Process exists to serve delivery, not the other way around
  • Pragmatism beats dogma; we adapt tools and rituals to reality
  • We value clarity, speed, and ownership over perfect frameworks
  • We iterate on process the same way we iterate on product

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a delivery or operations role tracking sprint mechanics — that’s Product Operations

• Not a Scrum Master

  • Not a passive requirements-taker; this role sets direction
  • Not detached from the field — you’ll spend meaningful time with customers and operations teams

Core Responsibilities

Customer & Domain Expertise

  • Spend regular time with customers — onsite where useful — to learn about their problems and understand their world
  • Represent the voice of the customer inside the company, and the voice of the roadmap to customers
  • Build and maintain deep knowledge of downstream O&G operations and how operators make decisions today

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Translate customer needs into new features, functionality, workflows and capabilities
  • Ensure your area of Orbital is adopted, used and creating value for customers
  • Translate downstream operational challenges — refining constraints, petrochemical process economics, safety and compliance — into a clear, prioritised backlog
  • Make and defend prioritisation calls, balancing near-term customer commitments with platform durability

Cross-Functional Delivery

  • Partner closely with research and engineering leads to scope, spec, and sequence work
  • Daily calibration of where your research and engineering colleagues should be focused on
  • In the details that matter - scoping requirements, testing hypotheses and iterating on the latest release
  • Coordinate with customer-facing project managers so committed timelines reflect real product and engineering capacity

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Communicate roadmap, rationale, and trade-offs clearly to leadership, engineering, and customers
  • Surface risks and scope trade-offs early — no surprises
  • Maintain artefacts such as roadmap documents, release notes, and customer-facing capability overviews

What Success Looks Like

First 60–90 Days

  • You’ve spent meaningful time with downstream customers and can speak fluently to their operational priorities
  • A clear, prioritised roadmap exists for your product area, understood by engineering and leadership
  • You’re the go-to person for “why are we building this” in your area

6–12 Months

  • Your product area ships features, functionality and workflows that measurably move customer-defined metrics — safety, uptime, margin, carbon intensity
  • Customer-facing and internal project managers are aligned on what’s being built and why
  • Your roadmap decisions are trusted by engineering, leadership, and customers alike

Are you passionate about building strategic customer partnerships while driving business growth and customer success?

Do you enjoy troubleshooting technical issues, delivering value-driven solutions, and collaborating with customers and cross-functional teams to achieve operational excellence?

Partnering with the Best

As a Sales Manager - Account Management, you will be responsible for managing key customer relationships, driving account growth, and ensuring the successful delivery of Drag Reducing Additives (DRA) programs. You will work closely with customers, account representatives, technicians, and cross-functional stakeholders to optimize customer operations, deliver technical solutions, and strengthen long-term strategic partnerships while supporting commercial objectives.

Fueling Your Passion

As a Sales Manager - Account Management, you will leverage your account management, technical sales, and customer relationship expertise to identify growth opportunities, support operational performance, deliver business reviews, and lead customer-focused solutions. You will play a critical role in ensuring customer satisfaction, business performance, and long-term account success.

As a Sales Manager - Account Management, you will be responsible for:

  • Building long-term strategic relationships by providing account management support while understanding customer business requirements and identifying sales opportunities.
  • Developing and executing account strategies that support revenue growth, customer retention, and business objectives.
  • Safely managing the day-to-day operations of Drag Reducing Additive (DRA) programs to ensure performance, reliability, and value delivery for customers.

  • Supporting a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Conducting all business activities in accordance with company health, safety, environmental, legal compliance, and ethical standards.

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline preferred.
  • Have experience in Sales, Account Management, Business Development, Customer Success, or a related commercial role.
  • Have a minimum of 3 years of experience in refining, petrochemical, industrial, midstream, chemical processing, or related industries.
  • Have experience building and managing strategic customer relationships.
  • Have experience leading and developing teams in a customer-facing environment.
  • Have a strong understanding of industrial chemical treatment technologies and sales processes.
  • Have strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Have previous laboratory experience and/or familiarity with analytical methods, data interpretation, and performance evaluations.
  • Have a comprehensive understanding of customer requirements and market conditions.
  • Have experience supporting technical sales activities and delivering customer-focused solutions.
  • Have strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Have the ability to present complex technical content to various levels of internal and external organizations in a clear and concise manner.
  • Have the ability to identify customer needs and translate them into business opportunities.
  • Have strong organizational, planning, and project management capabilities.
  • Have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Have the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multiple functions.
  • Have proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
  • Have the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of customer service.
  • Have a customer-focused mindset with a commitment to operational excellence and business results.
  • Have a demonstrated commitment to safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Have the ability to drive a company vehicle as required to perform job duties.
  • Have a TWIC Card or the ability to obtain a TWIC Card.

Work in a Way That Works for You

This role may require customer visits, account reviews, technical discussions, field support, equipment maintenance coordination, business planning activities, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to support customer success and business growth.


Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM, with flexibility to support customer and business requirements outside normal business hours as needed.


Travel Requirement: Up to 50% travel to support customer projects, business reviews, troubleshooting activities, equipment repairs, field support, and relationship-building initiatives.


Working with Us

Our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and performance-driven environment where leadership, innovation, customer focus, teamwork, and continuous improvement are encouraged and rewarded.


Working for You

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well-being, which may include:

  • Career development and leadership training opportunities
  • Medical and wellness benefits
  • Financial and retirement programs
  • Additional voluntary benefits

This position requires valid work authorization in the country of employment. The employer is unable to sponsor work authorization for this role at any time.

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans.

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.
