The Work

ICF is seeking a Directer, Project Management to lead integrated delivery for a modernization effort for the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s (FDIC). The program supports cloud data modernization, enterprise analytics and AI operations within FDIC’s governance and security environment.


You will provide the management structure that connects workstreams, technical teams, FDIC stakeholders, and delivery commitments. You will plan and sequence work, manage backlogs and sprint execution, monitor cost and schedule, control risks and changes, and ensure that work products are complete, traceable, secure, and ready for FDIC review and acceptance.


Job Location: Remote


What You Will Do

  • Lead program planning and execution across concurrent data, cloud, analytics, AI, and operations workstreams; maintain an integrated project plan and coordinate dependencies, milestones, and priorities.
  • Establish sprint plans with epics, backlog items, success criteria, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and sprint demonstrations; sequence work to support approved priorities and release objectives.
  • Manage the product backlog, requirements, code, artifacts, bug fixes, requirements baselines, system features, and business rules through FDIC GitHub Enterprise or approved tools.

  • Prepare weekly status reports covering cost, current and planned activities, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items; provide clear briefings to FDIC stakeholders.
  • Coordinate architecture, infrastructure, data, security, privacy, operations, and business stakeholder reviews; ensure decisions address cost, security, operations, technical standards, and mission requirements.
  • Manage requirements, risk, issue, change, and configuration processes, including FDIC Change Control Board and ServiceNow processes for production changes and configuration items.
  • Ensure deliverables and sprint outcomes meet acceptance criteria; coordinate quality reviews, continuous testing and validation, stakeholder feedback, and resolution of rework before submission.
  • Oversee security and compliance coordination, including A&A and ATO support, NIST 800-53 controls, POA&Ms, Azure policy findings, hardening guides, Security Impact Assessments, and annual security assessments.

raw.description:
ABOUT UNBOUNDED

We are a team of former classroom teachers, district and school leaders, curriculum writers, and education experts unified by our desire to see every student thrive in school.

Our commitment to every learner unites us. UnboundEd works side-by-side with teachers, coaches, principals, and district leaders to ensure every student has access to grade-level, engaging, affirming, and meaningful — GLEAM™ — instruction. By cultivating the mindsets, knowledge, and skills at the heart of truly transformative teaching and learning, we can break the predictability of historic achievement patterns so all kids thrive.

In 2023, UnboundEd joined forces with Pivot Learning and CORE Learning to expand our offerings and drive long-needed changes in instruction, especially in the highest-need schools.

POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, the Regional Director is a customer-facing role responsible for cultivating new partnerships, strengthening existing relationships, and promoting high-quality program engagements. This position requires occasional travel (up to 40%) to support customer meetings, conferences, and events.

This role is critical in UnboundEd’s sales strategy: qualifying leads, generating opportunities, and advancing them through the sales cycle. The Regional Director is ideal for an educator, consultative sales professional, or customer-focused leader eager to grow as part of a dynamic, mission-driven team. As a Regional Director, your work directly shapes educators' professional learning experiences, ensuring that students—particularly those historically underserved—receive the high-quality instruction they deserve.

This role requires a successful track record of quota attainment exceeding $2 million annually and is critical to UnboundEd’s sales strategy: actively prospecting, qualifying leads, generating pipeline, and closing complex district-level opportunities across the sales cycle.

UnboundEd is a virtual organization, and this exempt position can be based anywhere in the United States. UnboundEd has core business hours, during which we expect all staff to be available from 9 am to 5 pm local time. Candidates from the Southeast or Mid-America regions preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

Partnership Development

  • Develop a territory growth plan that aligns with annual revenue goals and key customer targets.
  • Leverage industry insights, data, and historical sales to identify top prospects and generate new opportunities.
  • Provide strategic consulting to your district partners to assist them in meeting their instructional objectives.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline; design sales strategies tailored to account/territory needs.
  • Accurately track accounts, opportunities, and next steps in the CRM.
  • Use CRM insights to advance opportunities through the sales cycle and close deals.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual and team revenue goals

Client Management

  • Provide strategic advice to district partners to help them achieve their goals.
  • Deliver high-quality interactions that create exceptional customer experiences.
  • Build trust and serve as a valued partner to schools and districts.
  • Develop expertise in all UnboundEd programs to recommend relevant professional learning solutions.
  • Actively listen, assess needs, and propose the best-fit services.
  • Lead customer meetings and strategies that drive engagement and long-term partnerships.
  • Provide consistent follow-up to ensure customer satisfaction and impact.
  • Stay current on industry trends through conferences, research, internal training, and professional learning.

Requirements

Location:

  • Remote (United States). We welcome candidates from across the country with experience building strong relationships with school and district leaders. Candidates from the Southeast or Mid-America regions preferred.

Education:

  • A bachelor’s degree is required (field open); an advanced degree is preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will also be considered.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience required; preference for supervisory, sales, or large-scale project leadership background.
  • A successful track record of quota attainment that exceeds $2 million annually.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

  • Commitment to UnboundEd’s organizational values and mission.
  • A learning orientation and dedication to equity and inclusion.
  • Knowledge of urban school environments.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while building strong cross-geography relationships.
  • A collaborative spirit and eagerness to contribute to a highly engaged team.
  • Entrepreneurial drive and adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Zoom, Salesforce, and collaboration tools such as Slack.

Benefits

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

UnboundEd offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience. The annual salary hiring range for this position is $100,000 to $125,000, plus an incentive compensation plan that can bring on-track earnings to $200K-$250K.

UnboundEd bases compensation offers on relevant years of experience, internal equity, and company budgets. Because of our strong commitment to equity and growth, UnboundEd does not negotiate compensation offers.

We also offer a generous benefits package that includes take-as-you-need vacation time, group medical, dental, and vision plans, disability and life insurance plans, and an employer-sponsored 401K retirement plan with a 5% employer contribution and no vesting period.

Beyond pay and benefits, UnboundEd offers a collaborative, mission-driven environment where your work directly impacts educators and students nationwide.

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director, Digital & Performance Marketing, you will be tasked with building and scaling an AI-first performance marketing engine that drives pipeline, revenue, and growth efficiency, architecting a self-optimizing digital system that continuously informs where we invest, who we target, and how we convert. This is not a traditional demand gen or media role: you will connect audience, intent, creative, and data into a real-time, signal-driven growth engine that consistently produces a high-quality pipeline and accelerates revenue. This role sits at the center of Revenue Marketing and directly impacts pipeline creation, conversion, and CAC efficiency.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Define and own the digital marketing strategy aligned to pipeline and revenue goals; translate business priorities into clear investment strategies, channel mix, and audience focus; identify market opportunities, whitespace, and growth levers to inform planning; act as a key contributor to annual and quarterly planning, influencing budget allocation and strategic bets.
  • Build and scale a digital-first pipeline generation engine across paid media, intent signals, and account-based engagement; own performance across the funnel, from engagement to pipeline to revenue; architect and optimize a multi-channel engagement strategy spanning SEM, paid social, programmatic display, CTV, audio/podcasts, Reddit, and programmatic OOH, leveraging each channel's strengths to drive coordinated, signal-based engagement across the buyer journey; use AI-driven bidding and budget allocation tools to shift spend across channels in real time, based on performance, intent signals, and account engagement; ensure programs are optimized for pipeline quality, conversion, and velocity, not just lead volume; establish clear linkage between media investment and business outcomes.
  • Translate ICP, personas, and segmentation into actionable target audiences across channels; leverage first-party and third-party intent data, engagement signals, and account insights to prioritize spend; apply AI and predictive modeling to score accounts, surface buying signals, and prioritize outreach before a lead even raises their hand; use a CDP (e.g., Hightouch) to unify first-party data and activate it across paid and owned channels; leverage identity resolution and data collaboration tools (e.g., LiveRamp) to extend audience match rates and connect online and offline signals; partner with Marketing Ops and Data Analytics teams to operationalize signal-driven decision making and continuously refine targeting based on in-market behavior and performance data.
  • Set the AI roadmap for the digital marketing function, including which tools, which use cases, and which workflows get automated first; evaluate and pilot AI platforms for media buying, audience modeling, creative generation, and campaign optimization; build AI-assisted creative testing workflows that generate, test, and iterate ad variants faster than manual processes allow; establish guardrails for responsible AI use in targeting, personalization, and content generation; track where AI is actually moving the needle on CAC, pipeline velocity, and conversion, and kill what is not working; keep the team current on new AI capabilities relevant to performance marketing and push adoption where it drives results.
  • Build and lead a structured experimentation framework across channels, creative, offers, and landing experiences; use performance data and AI-powered analysis to identify drivers of success and areas for optimization; continuously evolve performance benchmarks and redefine what great looks like.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a team of high-performing digital marketers; establish a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement; elevate team capabilities across strategy, execution, AI fluency, and data fluency; set and maintain a high bar for performance, creativity, and impact.
  • Lead cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing Ops, Data Analytics, and Regional/Field Marketing to keep digital strategy aligned with business priorities; partner with Geo Leaders to manage expectations and act as the digital voice in regional business reviews; share regional performance, pipeline creation progress, and digital engagement insights with Geo Leaders on a regular cadence; translate global digital strategy into regional context, and surface regional needs back into the broader strategy.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 10 or more years of experience in B2B digital or performance marketing, with cybersecurity experience a major plus; experience in cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise SaaS is preferred.
  • Proven ability to define and lead marketing strategy, not just execute campaigns, with experience influencing planning cycles, investment decisions, and GTM strategy.
  • Strong understanding of how digital marketing drives pipeline, revenue, and growth efficiency, and a demonstrated track record of driving measurable pipeline impact and ROI.
  • Deep expertise across paid media, audience targeting, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools, such as predictive bidding, AI creative generation, account scoring models, or similar.
  • Strong experience leveraging first-party and third-party intent data, account scoring and segmentation, multi-channel audience orchestration, and AI/ML-driven optimization and automation.
  • Proficiency with modern martech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase), and the ability to translate data into clear insights and actionable strategy.
  • Proven ability to build or transform digital functions into scalable, AI-enabled revenue engines, with strong test-and-learn discipline and a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, with a bias for action and strong ownership and accountability.
  • Player/coach mindset with experience leading and developing teams, strong cross-functional collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Ops, and Analytics, and excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity and drive alignment.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave

Work Perks & Flexibility

Bilingual Medical Administrative Coordinator

Location: Remote - Nicaragua
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (Telecommute)

Languages: Advanced English (C1/C2) and Fluent Spanish
Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

Our client is a growing U.S.-based healthcare support organization that provides remote administrative and operational assistance to medical practices across the United States.

The company partners with healthcare professionals to simplify administrative processes, improve practice efficiency, and ensure that medical teams can focus more of their time on patient care.

Its remote workforce supports essential healthcare operations, including patient documentation, insurance coordination, authorization requests, and provider-related administrative processes.

With an emphasis on accuracy, reliable communication, and efficient workflows, the organization continues expanding its remote support teams to meet the needs of healthcare providers across different medical specialties.

About the Role

We are seeking Bilingual Medical Administrative Coordinators to provide remote operational and administrative support to U.S.-based healthcare practices.

In this position, you will help medical teams manage patient information, coordinate insurance-related processes, maintain electronic health records, and support documentation required for prescriptions, authorizations, and provider enrollment.

You will interact with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and patients to ensure administrative requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with previous medical administration or healthcare support experience, strong organizational skills, and the ability to communicate professionally in both English and Spanish.

What You'll Do

Medical Records & Patient Information

  • Review and update patient demographic information in electronic health record systems.

  • Maintain accurate and organized EMR/EHR documentation.

  • Upload and organize laboratory reports, referrals, clinical notes, and other medical documents.

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefit information.

  • Identify missing or incomplete records and coordinate necessary updates.

  • Support accurate and confidential handling of patient information.

Insurance Verification & Authorization Coordination

  • Assist with medical, procedure-related, and prescription prior authorizations.

  • Collect required information and supporting clinical documentation.

  • Submit authorization requests and monitor their progress.

  • Communicate with insurance carriers regarding pending decisions and additional requirements.

  • Follow up on authorization denials, appeals, and outstanding documentation.

  • Keep authorization records updated to support timely healthcare services.

Prescription & Pharmacy Administration

  • Coordinate administrative processing of prescription refill requests.

  • Communicate with pharmacies regarding medication-related requests.

  • Track prescription authorization statuses and pending responses.

  • Help resolve documentation issues that may delay prescription processing.

  • Keep healthcare teams informed about outstanding medication-related requests.

Provider Credentialing Support

  • Assist with administrative tasks related to provider enrollment with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.

  • Update and maintain provider information in CAQH and other credentialing platforms.

  • Track credentialing applications and enrollment progress.

  • Monitor important provider documentation, including professional licenses, DEA registrations, and malpractice insurance.

  • Help identify upcoming credential expirations and outstanding enrollment requirements.

Healthcare Administrative Operations

  • Communicate with patients, providers, pharmacies, and insurance companies.

  • Maintain organized records of requests, updates, and follow-up activities.

  • Support daily administrative processes across medical practices.

  • Coordinate outstanding tasks to help reduce administrative delays.

  • Handle protected health information responsibly and maintain patient confidentiality.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in medical administration, medical reception, healthcare virtual assistance, medical records, prior authorizations, credentialing, or a related healthcare support position.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2) and fluent Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • Experience verifying patient insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Familiarity with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) or Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems.

  • Understanding of healthcare administrative procedures and medical documentation.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.

  • Professional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

  • Commitment to protecting confidential patient information and maintaining accurate records.

Preferred

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based medical practices or healthcare providers.

  • Familiarity with medical or pharmacy prior authorization processes.

  • Experience with provider credentialing and insurance enrollment.

  • Knowledge of CAQH, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance requirements.

  • Understanding of HIPAA regulations and healthcare documentation standards.

What Makes a Strong Candidate?

We are particularly interested in professionals who demonstrate:

  • Accuracy: You carefully review patient records, insurance details, and medical documentation.

  • Organization: You can manage several administrative processes without losing track of important information.

  • Follow-through: You consistently monitor pending requests and take action when additional information is needed.

  • Communication: You interact professionally with healthcare teams, patients, and insurance representatives.

  • Adaptability: You can work across different administrative workflows and learn new procedures.

  • Confidentiality: You understand the importance of protecting sensitive healthcare information.

How Success Is Measured

  • Patient records and electronic medical documentation remain complete and accurate.

  • Insurance eligibility information is verified and updated appropriately.

  • Prior authorization requests are submitted and followed up on efficiently.

  • Prescription-related administrative requests are coordinated in a timely manner.

  • Provider credentialing documentation and enrollment records remain organized.

  • Pending requests are tracked and communicated effectively.

  • Medical teams receive reliable administrative support that contributes to efficient daily operations.

  • Patient information is handled according to applicable confidentiality and compliance requirements.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% remote opportunity supporting healthcare operations in the United States.

  • Join an expanding healthcare support organization.

  • Gain experience across multiple areas of medical administration.

  • Work with insurance verification, EMR/EHR systems, prior authorizations, and provider documentation.

  • Develop specialized skills in U.S. healthcare administrative processes.

  • Contribute to smoother operations for medical professionals and their patients.

Important Notes

  • Advanced English (C1/C2) and fluent Spanish are required.

  • Candidates must have at least 1 year of relevant healthcare administrative experience.

  • Experience with insurance verification and EMR/EHR systems is required.

  • Previous exposure to U.S. healthcare practices is highly valued.

  • The position requires availability during U.S. business hours.

  • This is an administrative support position; clinical responsibilities are not part of the role.

This is a fully remote position.

raw.excerpt: Our CompanyThe North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.
raw.description:
Our Company

The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

Your Impact

NERC seeks a mission-focused individual who wants to make a difference by supporting the reliability of the North American electric grid. The Compliance Assurance Advisor is primarily responsible for providing oversight, guidance, and coordination in managing programs and processes to monitor, review, and evaluate program effectiveness of the ERO Enterprise implementation of risk-based compliance monitoring and adherence to the NERC Rules of Procedure, Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program, Certification Program, and approved delegation agreements. The Compliance Assurance Advisor also supports the development, implementation, and oversight of the Certification Program for Reliability Coordinators, Balancing Authorities, and Transmission Operators.

In addition, the Compliance Assurance Advisor develops and delivers outreach and training related to risk-based compliance monitoring, certification, and compliance guidance implementation. This position reports to the Manager, Compliance Assurance.

Your Role

  • Develop and manage compliance assurance activities, including associated project plans, to develop and implement a high-quality risk-based compliance monitoring and certification program.
  • Develop and execute oversight programs/processes/activities to evaluate Regional Entity adherence to the NERC Rules of Procedure, Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program, and delegation agreements.
  • Provide operations subject matter expertise related to risk management, auditing, and internal controls in support of a high-quality risk-based compliance monitoring and certification program.
  • Identify, develop, and effectively deliver training and outreach to Regional Entities and industry participants.
  • Provide Compliance Assurance department leadership with recommendations to improve the regional compliance oversight program.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and assist in the ongoing development and improvement of NERC compliance monitoring and enforcement program policies, procedures, rules, and other activities.
  • Develop and manage relationships with NERC committees, subcommittees, working groups, and industry stakeholder groups.
  • Execute, control, and proactively manage project schedules, including risk identification, risk mitigation, and change management.
  • Report on project status, risks, and achievement of key milestones.
  • Collect and analyze data to detect deficient controls and noncompliance with NERC rules and agreements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have at a minimum:

  • A bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university, or equivalent experience.
  • At least five years of progressive and successful experience leading operations projects, teams, and/or initiatives in a technically and operationally complex business/organization.
  • Experience in identifying training needs, designing, developing, and delivering technical training programs, and evaluating their effectiveness.
  • Progressive experience in auditing, internal controls, enterprise risk management, and related governance, risk, and control (GRC) frameworks and standards.
  • Advanced project management and analytical experience.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with minimal direct supervision.
  • Competence in interpersonal communications, with the ability to interact diplomatically with people from many levels of industry and government.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including editing and proofreading skills.
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office tools including Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Demonstrated group facilitation skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly.

Preferred candidates will also have:

  • Knowledge of the NERC Rules of Procedure, NERC Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program, and NERC Reliability Standards.
  • Prior experience in regulatory compliance oversight and enforcement within a recognized industry, government, or government-authorized agency, especially in conducting performance audits or analysis of program effectiveness of government agency operations (e.g., GAO or other federal or state-level equivalent experience).
  • At least five years of experience in systems operations and/or planning in the electric sector or utility industry.
  • Working knowledge of operations of inverter-based resources (IBRs).
  • Advanced knowledge and application of professional auditing standards and principles, such as COSO, GAGAS, and IIA.
  • Program design or procedure writing.
  • Training Certification (Training development, facilitating, or other).

Other

  • A background check will be conducted prior to employment.
  • In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
  • This position has been classified as exempt.
  • The position may be based remotely but must be able to travel to NERC offices or meeting locations if needed. Reimbursement of travel expenses will be in accordance with the company’s travel and expense reimbursement policies.

Our Culture Declarations

  • Everyone at NERC is a leader.
  • We are accountable personally and organizationally to deliver on commitments.
  • We develop ourselves and people in the organization to ensure that NERC realizes its strategic objectives.
  • We are resilient and adaptable to the challenges and needs of the business and our team.
  • We exude a growth mindset and empower teams to take risks.
  • We build collaborative relationships within NERC, the ERO, and the stakeholders of NERC.
  • We exemplify NERC cultural behaviors:
    • Reward high-quality, creative, and innovative work
    • Attract, engage, and retain top talent
    • Value and respect diverse perspectives
    • Provide a safe, inclusive, and collaborative work environment
    • Form strong relationships within the company, and with the ERO Enterprise
  • We demonstrate curiosity in a wide variety of areas and are open to exploring new situations, knowledge, and opportunities for growth and development.
  • We demonstrate an anticipatory mindset, preventing problems and building contingencies where appropriate.
  • We are champions for diversity and inclusion, seeking out and values diverse perspectives.
  • We value well-being, prioritizing collaboration, engagement, and connection among our team.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Greg also owns or is very active in significant customer-facing and strategic partnership activities and is the primary leader for our M&A initiatives.   • Drive the cross functional preparation for our Senior leadership meetings, managing the agenda and materials.

  • Help set up, build the agenda for and manage a regular cadence for the CTO to have customer and partner calls, capturing and following up on action items from these meetings.

  • M&A operations - driving the organization, communication and program flow related to Mergers & Acquisitions.

  • Facilitate an ongoing CTO outreach to the organization via round table sessions and skip level 1:1s, prompting key topics for discussion, capturing employee sentiments and following up on action items or opportunities identified.

What we are looking for:

  • The ability to enter an unknown environment, assess and develop the plan you feel necessary to accelerate and improve all operational rigor, communication and cross-functional accountability of the CTO’s business unit.

  • Exceptional operational, organizational and communication skills.

  • Executive level presentation creation and delivery skills

  • Demonstrated expertise executing on clear and diligent follow-up and communication at the most senior levels, both internally and externally

  • A track record of successfully coordinating multiple cross-departmental efforts that achieved meaningful business outcomes across all levels of the organization

  • The ability to manage scope, risk, and uncertainty.

  • Demonstrated ability to streamline operational processes for consistency and efficiency.

  • Proactive approach to spotting potential issues and solving problems.

  • Someone who thrives in the pace and culture of a fast moving and rapidly growing SaaS business.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.

Language:

To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

We are looking for an experienced Licensed Insurance Customer Service Representative (P&C) to support U.S.-based insurance agencies with policy servicing, quoting, renewals, and customer support.

In this client-facing role, you will work directly with policyholders, prospects, insurance carriers, and agency teams to ensure timely, accurate, and professional service. You will assist with policy updates, prepare insurance quotes, answer coverage questions, and help agencies deliver an exceptional customer experience.

We are seeking candidates who hold an active U.S. Property & Casualty (P&C) license (resident or non-resident). If additional state licenses are required, the client will assist with obtaining them.

Responsibilities

Policy Servicing

  • Maintain detailed documentation of customer interactions and policy activities.

Quoting & Customer Support

  • Follow up with prospects and existing clients regarding quotes and renewals.

Carrier & Agency Coordination

  • Communicate with insurance carriers regarding underwriting requirements, policy changes, and coverage questions.
  • Maintain accurate records within the agency management system.
  • Process policy documentation and client requests efficiently.
  • Collaborate with internal agency teams to ensure seamless customer support.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You hold an active U.S. Property & Casualty (P&C) license (resident or non-resident).
  • You enjoy helping clients understand their insurance coverage and providing excellent customer service.
  • You communicate confidently and professionally over the phone and via email.
  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple client requests simultaneously.
  • You thrive in a remote work environment and can work independently with minimal supervision.
  • You understand the importance of accuracy, compliance, and delivering a positive client experience.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Active U.S. Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance License (resident or non-resident).
  • Minimum 1 year of Property & Casualty insurance experience with an insurance agency or carrier.
  • Experience in Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, or both.
  • Comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls with policyholders, prospects, and insurance carriers.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Must be located outside of the United States.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated home office.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting both Personal Lines and Commercial Lines.
  • Familiarity with major U.S. insurance carriers.
  • Experience using agency management systems such as Applied Epic, AMS360, HawkSoft, EZLynx, QQCatalyst, Vertafore, or similar platforms.
  • Previous experience working remotely for a U.S.-based insurance agency.
  • Experience supporting multiple insurance producers or agency teams.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing new policy requests, endorsements, renewals, and customer inquiries. Throughout the day, you'll assist clients with policy servicing, prepare insurance quotes, respond to phone calls and emails, coordinate with insurance carriers, and follow up on outstanding requests.

You'll document all activities within the agency management system, collaborate with agency staff, and ensure every client receives accurate, timely, and professional service. Success in this role comes from delivering exceptional customer support, maintaining compliance, and helping agencies build long-term relationships with their clients.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Client Interview
  • Offer Stage

What happens after you apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video, completed once on your own time, and it’s the final step that completes your application.

Here’s why we do it this way. Instead of repeating yourself on screening call after screening call, you tell your story once and it carries forward. Hiring managers get to see how you actually communicate before you meet, so when you’re a fit, the first conversation isn’t starting from scratch. Fewer interviews, and the ones you do have count for more.

Don’t overthink it. Record it as many times as you like—nobody sees the takes you discard. Just be yourself. Your Intro Video invitation will come from Spark Hire, our trusted video interview platform, so please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the email.

Software Engineering Manager

Location: Remote | Team: Engineering – Enterprise Learning & Skills

About the Role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of 5–8 software engineers on the Enterprise Learning & Skills (ELS) engineering team. The team builds, scales, and evolves a large-scale, API-driven platform used globally to issue and verify digital credentials. This is a people- and delivery-focused leadership role: you'll own the day-to-day health, output, and growth of the team, ensuring work stays on track, meets our standards for quality and consistency, and delivers what the organization and our customers expect.

You'll allocate and prioritize daily work, clear blockers, clarify requirements, and give real-time feedback so engineers can do their best work. You'll be the first line of support when coding or system issues surface, deciding what the team can resolve and what needs to be escalated to senior engineering leadership. You'll also own onboarding and skill development for new team members, and you'll partner closely with Product, Customer Success, and external vendors to turn requirements into reliable, well-sequenced delivery. You don't need to write production code, but you do need enough technical depth to guide design discussions, hold the team to strong engineering practices, and ask the right questions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of 5–8 engineers building Ruby on Rails services and React frontends, owning the team's well-being, performance, and immediate output

  • Plan and allocate daily and sprint work, monitor progress against delivery schedules, and keep projects on track through clear priorities and timely course corrections

  • Troubleshoot obstacles, clarify requirements, and coordinate handoffs across engineers, teams, and vendors so blockers are resolved quickly and together

  • Triage bugs and production issues with attention to detail, minimizing disruption to the customers who rely on our platform

  • Maintain standards of quality and consistency within our defined processes, including coding and QA standards, code review coverage, test thoroughness, and team documentation

  • Give real-time, constructive feedback; run regular 1:1s; and celebrate team milestones while openly recognizing individual contributions

  • Own the onboarding and skill development of new team members, reducing ramp-up time and onboarding errors

  • Identify and introduce process improvements at the team level, within defined limits, and escalate unresolved or higher-impact issues to senior engineering leadership in a timely way

  • Champion the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, documentation, and debugging across the team

  • Uphold secure, ethical, and resilient engineering practices, including data and information security expectations, across everything the team ships

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience and 2+ years managing or formally leading a software engineering team

  • Working familiarity with our core stack (Ruby on Rails, React, AWS, PostgreSQL) and with API management, cloud computing, DevOps practices, and software design, with enough technical acumen to guide discussions and evaluate trade-offs

  • Proven track record of running a team's daily delivery reliably: consistent adherence to coding and QA standards, accurate and timely task completion, and dependable schedules

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a habit of identifying challenges early, evaluating options, and driving practical resolutions

  • Exceptional collaboration and communication, equally effective with engineers, non-technical stakeholders, and external vendors

  • Experience onboarding and developing engineers, with evidence of shortened ramp-up times and growing team capability

  • Sound judgment about when to resolve issues locally and when to escalate, and a record of escalating clearly and promptly

  • Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning as the team, platform, and tooling evolve

  • Strong understanding of information and data security fundamentals and an ethical, customer-centric approach to decisions

AI-Native Expectations

You should be comfortable using AI tools in your own work and confident guiding a team that uses them for coding, testing, documentation, and learning. You'll set expectations for how AI-generated output is validated, help the team build sound judgment about when to rely on it and when not to, and stay curious about how AI agents and automated AI can responsibly improve productivity and quality across the team.

How Success Is Measured

High performers in this role are recognized by their team's consistent adherence to coding and QA standards, the speed and accuracy of task completion, and the reliability of daily delivery schedules. Timely escalation of unresolved issues, high coverage on code review, and the successful introduction of team-level process improvements are central to success. The readiness of new staff, evidenced by reduced ramp-up times and fewer onboarding errors, also features in performance assessment.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on background as a Rails, React, or full-stack engineer before moving into management

  • Experience designing, deploying, or operating production workloads on AWS and Azure, and familiarity with CI/CD and automated deployment practices

  • Experience managing work delivered in partnership with third-party or vendor teams

  • Experience with resilience planning, incident management, or on-call processes for customer-facing systems

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems and asynchronous, event-driven communication between services

  • Experience introducing AI agents or automated AI tooling into an engineering team's workflow

Specialist Service Management (IC20)

Role Overview

Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS) is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Business Analyst to support business and product decisions through data analysis, process evaluation, and stakeholder collaboration. This role serves as a key partner between business stakeholders, Product Management, School Operations, Technology, and Engineering teams.

The Business Analyst contributes to discovery activities, research, business process analysis, requirements documentation, and solution validation efforts supporting students, families, educators, and school operations. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, systems thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a desire to build expertise in business analysis practices.

Success in this role requires effective collaboration, ability to work effectively within defined objectives and evolving priorities, attention to detail, and the ability to translate business needs into actionable recommendations and requirements that are aligned to business objectives. This role helps identify opportunities to improve processes, enhance user experiences, and support scalable solutions aligned with organizational priorities.

What You'll Do

Business Analysis & Discovery

  • Participate in discovery efforts to understand business problems, user needs, operational challenges, and strategic opportunities.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews, process reviews, and requirements gathering sessions with support from senior team members when appropriate.
  • Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization, simplification, automation, and improved efficiency.

Requirements Management

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Full-Time, Remote / Salary, Exempt / Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno is growing! We're looking for a Strategic Operations Manager to join our winning team, which is revolutionizing the legal services industry every single day. You're equally at home building a dashboard that makes a trend obvious to a non-technical colleague and running the workshop that turns that insight into a new workflow. You're a self-starter who is energized by ambiguity, prioritizes with limited oversight, and presents with confidence to stakeholders at every level. raw.description:
The RA & PV specialist will act as Local Country Person Responsible for Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory Affairs (LCPPV/LCPRA) and serves as the primary local RA&PV representative to ensure compliance with national pharmacovigilance and regulatory requirements in Australia. This position is responsible for executing PV and RA activities at the local level, supporting the Marketing Authorisation Holder (MAH) in maintaining product compliance throughout its lifecycle.

Main responsibilities

  • Prompt and effective communication with MAH and local regulatory authorities as required
  • Primary contact person with local regulatory authorities for Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance as per local requirements
  • Provision of local regulatory intelligence screening and expert advice for the responsible region(s)
  • Collection and reporting of locally suspected ADRs or ICSRs (FUs, translations)
  • Local management / oversight of risk minimization measures related to urgent safety restrictions and emerging safety issues
  • Support with development and implementation of local pharmacovigilance system in compliance with Global MAH's system and local regulations
  • Perform local non-indexed literature screening and screening of regulatory authority website/s for potential Adverse Drug Reactions (ADRs) and safety information
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation at local level
  • Provide support to the RA & PV Global operations team
  • Preparation and collection of documentation for submissions to the regulatory authorities
  • Review and linguistic input on local Product Information and Mock-ups
  • Ensure compliance with MAH's and PrimeVigilance's procedures
  • Support audits and Inspections
  • Handle local QA tasks such as suspected falsified products, quality alerts received from health authorities and other quality-related requirements received from the local market
  • Bachelor's Degree in Life Sciences or Chemistry, Nursing or equivalent professional experience
  • At least 3 years of pharmacovigilance or safety-related experience in pharmaceutical, CRO, or regulatory environment
  • Good understanding of ICH GVP and local pharmacovigilance requirements (training or practical exposure)
  • Experience in case handling, literature screening, or local PV activities is preferred
  • Prior experience in Regulatory Affairs is preferred but not mandatory
  • Proficiency in English and additional language knowledge is advantageous
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

Job Description


Skills and Experience:

  • Board-certified physician (emergency medicine, internal medicine, or family medicine preferred) with 5+ years in clinical practice, willing to continue practicing in a virtual care setting.
  • Experience leading and managing clinicians, including advanced practice providers.
  • Experience building or scaling a clinical program or service line, not just operating within one.
  • Comfort working with engineering, product, and data teams. You don't need to write code, but you need to think clearly about how technology shapes care delivery.
  • Experience designing interventions to improve population health outcomes and an understanding of how to measure and track care quality.
  • Experience working in interdisciplinary teams across clinical and non-clinical functions.
  • Experience with virtual care, Medicare populations, or urgent care preferred.

A bit more about this role:

Devoted Medical, Devoted Health's virtual-first, AI-native medical group delivering multi-specialty and advanced primary care, is seeking a dynamic, experienced, and mission-driven Physician Leader to serve as the Medical Director, Care Ondemand. This is a highly impactful position: you will serve as the clinical leader of a portfolio of clinical services that serves as the clinical backbone in our organization. This includes leading our virtual primary care extension, virtual urgent care, virtual observation unit (episodic care). The service operates 24/7 and ensures that all members of Devoted Health have a way to access care.


This represents an amazing opportunity for an ambitious clinician-leader with an entrepreneurial streak. As the Medical Director for Care Ondemand, you are responsible for building a team and an operation to handle the acute and routine needs of our membership. Specifically, you will provide clinical leadership for the 3 layers of Devoted’s Care Ondemand Program: (1) Care OnDemand - inbound triage and virtual / digital immediate care (2) Primary Care Extension- enterprise wide immediate care support for low acuity PCP extension care (3) Virtual Observation Unit - multi-day care of acute clinical issues (e.g. CHF exacerbation or complicated infections) by an interprofessional team. All functions of the service are supported by a rapidly expanding digital platform and AI-powered care tools.


In short, we want to build an unprecedented access point to care and meet the needs of our members in a way they thought imaginable - well before they feel compelled to use urgent care or the emergency room unnecessarily.


On a day to day basis, you’d be responsible for:

  • Developing and evolving the vision for the service line including expansion into increasingly AI-enabled digital channels
  • Clinical architect of the care model
  • Provide direct patient care and available for clinical escalations
  • Direct leadership of the clinical managers - and indirectly the entire Care on Demand clinical staff (RN, NP, MDs)
  • Managing vendors and technology needed to achieve success (e.g. mobile radiology, mobile phlebotomy)
  • Coordinating with Devoted’s network leaders and community primary care practices to ensure continuity and cohesive care
  • Cross-functional coordination within Devoted (e.g. Marketing) to promote utilization of the service line

Who thrives in this role:

  • You are an excellent clinician who cares deeply about the well-being of your patients and brings strong judgment to both clinical and operational decisions.
  • You are a builder. You can stand up a new service line from scratch and manage all the parts: people, operations, vendors, technology, and cross-organizational coordination.
  • You are energized by AI and technology and see them as tools to make care better, not threats to the craft of medicine.
  • You are a happy warrior. In a great environment with smart, caring people working toward a common aim, you are comfortable working hard.
  • You are wired for learning, change, and rapid iteration. You would rather try something, learn, and adjust than wait for perfect information.
  • You think in terms of the big picture and sweat the details. You can present a vision to leadership and then turn around and solve a workflow problem on the front line.

If you want to build something that has never existed before, at the intersection of clinical medicine, technology, and operational excellence, and do it alongside a team that is as talented as it is kind, we'd love to hear from you.


About Devoted Medical:

Devoted Medical is the clinical engine of Devoted Health, a next-generation health company built from the ground up to care for every person like family. Devoted Medical is a virtual-first, AI-native medical group where nearly 700 clinicians delivered over 200,000 encounters last year. Our clinicians spend as much time as each patient needs, end the day with their notes done, and consistently describe this as the best work of their careers with a team of coworkers that is warm, intelligent, and mission-driven. And Devoted Medical is at the cutting edge of technology, powered by more than 5,000 AI agents built into every workflow. The results back it up: patient trust scores of 98.9%, satisfaction ratings of 4.9 out of 5, healthier patients with fewer readmissions, fewer acute events, better controlled chronic disease, and medical costs 42% below traditional Medicare benchmarks. We're scaling rapidly and just getting started. If you want to practice medicine the way it should be practiced, with the technology, time, and team to actually do it, this is the place.


Salary Range:$335,000 - $387,000 / year base salary



The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

Location: Remote Job Type: Full-time (starts as a paid 1-month trial) Compensation: $400–$600 USD/month (based on experience)
Reports to: Amazon PPC Lead

About the Role

We're looking for an Amazon PPC Admin to support our senior Amazon PPC Specialists with the day-to-day operational work behind our advertising and product launch strategy. This is a hands-on, entry-to-mid-level role suited to someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to build a career in Amazon advertising and e-commerce growth.

You'll start by taking ownership of admin, data, and setup tasks that keep our PPC operations running smoothly — and over time, you'll be coached directly by senior PPC specialists and given real ownership over some of our smaller marketplaces, including Amazon Mexico and Amazon Australia.

If you're coachable, curious, and want to learn Amazon PPC, Meta-to-Amazon product launches, custom landing page setup, and tools like Scale Insights, this is a great entry point into a growing e-commerce advertising career.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Gathering, organizing, and maintaining data across spreadsheets and internal trackers
  • Setting up and managing ClickUp tasks and preparation checklists for product launches
  • Building and maintaining spreadsheets for product launches and campaign tracking
  • Setting up landing pages for Meta-to-Amazon marketing pushes
  • Setting up and maintaining keyword tracking systems
  • Supporting the team with Amazon case log submissions and follow-ups
  • Assisting with the setup of PPC campaigns under guidance from senior specialists
  • Taking on hands-on ownership of PPC support for smaller marketplaces (Amazon Mexico, Amazon Australia) as you grow into the role

What We're Looking For

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel) and task management tools (ClickUp or similar)
  • Clear written communication skills
  • A proactive, "figure-it-out" attitude and genuine eagerness to learn
  • Coachable ; open to feedback and hands-on training
  • Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently in a remote setup

Nice to Have

  • Amazon PPC experience
  • Experience supporting an Amazon product launch
  • Familiarity with Data Dive or similar keyword/market research tools
  • Experience building PPC tracking spreadsheets
  • Basic understanding of listing optimization
  • Keyword research experience

Growth Path

This role is designed as a launchpad, not a dead end:

  1. Month 1: Paid trial period
  2. After trial: Transition to full-time PPC Admin
  3. After 1 year: Guaranteed one-on-one coaching from senior PPC specialists in a supportive, hands-on environment with growing ownership over live marketplace campaigns

You'll be learning real strategy, not just admin — including Amazon PPC, Meta-to-Amazon launch playbooks, custom landing page design for product launches, and PPC management via Scale Insights.

Compensation & Structure

  • Pay: $400–$600 USD per month
  • Structure: 1-month paid trial Full-time role PPC Admin
  • Reporting line: Amazon PPC Lead
  • We use Hubstaff for transparent time tracking and seamless remote team collaboration.

CURRENT OPPORTUNITIES

We're currently hiring Sr. Estimators within our Solar Business Unit.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Senior Estimator, you'll play a key role in developing competitive, innovative, and technically sound proposals for utility-scale renewable energy projects. Working closely with Engineering, Integrated Supply Chain, Construction, and Project Management, you'll develop conceptual electrical solutions that help bring projects from early opportunity through contract award.

A typical day may involve reviewing Owner RFPs, evaluating electrical designs, coordinating with Engineers of Record (EOR), utilities, equipment suppliers, and internal stakeholders, while preparing estimates for collection systems, substations, underground cable systems, utility interconnections, SCADA, protection and control systems, and other electrical infrastructure. You'll identify technical risks, evaluate constructability, develop value engineering solutions, and help position projects for successful execution.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Identifies and calculates cost of project safety requirements (training, ppe) into bid. Identifies and determines JHA risks and includes costs in estimates. Pursues, selects and utilizes subcontractors who meet DHB risk management criteria.
  • Displays personal and professional ethics and complies with and enforces company policies and procedures when bidding projects, including utilizing company estimating software, performing bid reviews, etc. Takes personal responsibility to ensure that a quality bid has been produced.
  • Plan the estimate for and during the pre-bid meeting. Create preliminary project schedule during estimate.
  • Supervises and provides development of subordinates through mentoring, formal training and exposure to diverse work experiences.
  • Conduct project site visits and review cost/production reports to compare actual cost and plan to estimate and conduct special studies to develop and establish standard cost data.
  • Review proposal specifications and drawings to determine scope of work, required contents of estimate and critical tasks to complete the project. Review design options and recommend best solution based on cost, materials, etc. Calculate statistical data necessary for bid: quantity take-offs, materials, labor, equipment, and specialty items.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED


  • Four-year construction or engineering degree with five to seven years of experience as an Estimator or equivalent combinations of technical training and/or related experience in mathematics including algebra and geometry; or equivalent training and/or experience; with an emphasis in Renewable Construction – focusing on Solar, Wind and BESS techniques.
  • Valid Driver’s License.
  • Some travel is required.

WHAT SETS YOU APART


  • Experience supporting utility-scale renewable energy or power infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of collection systems, substations, utility interconnections, underground cable systems, protection and control systems, SCADA, grounding, and power delivery infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting value engineering, constructability reviews, technical risk assessments, and proposal development.
  • Experience collaborating with Owners, Engineers of Record (EOR), utilities, Engineering, Integrated Supply Chain, and Construction teams.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay

  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

raw.description:
Secretome Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Plano, Texas, developing novel therapies derived from neonatal cardiac progenitor cells (nCPC). The Company's lead product candidate, STM-01, is a cellular therapy designed to modulate inflammatory and fibrotic pathways and support myocardial function in Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) and Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF). Secretome is also advancing STM-21, a secretome-based therapeutic currently in preclinical development, and other novel nCPC-based products.

About the role

Secretome Therapeutics is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Director of Data Management to lead the strategy, execution, and oversight of clinical data management activities across our development portfolio. This individual will be responsible for ensuring the quality, integrity, completeness, and timely delivery of clinical trial data while building scalable processes and standards to support the company's growth. The Director of Data Management will serve as a key cross-functional leader, partnering with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, and external vendors to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies and regulatory submissions.

What you'll do

  • Lead all clinical data management activities across Secretome's clinical development programs.
  • Develop and implement data management strategies, standards, processes, and best practices to support study execution and regulatory compliance.
  • Oversee protocol review, eCRF design, database development, edit check specifications, user acceptance testing, data cleaning, reconciliation activities, coding, and database lock.
  • Manage and oversee CROs, data management vendors, and technology providers to ensure quality deliverables, timeline adherence, and budget compliance.
  • Establish and maintain data governance frameworks that ensure data quality, integrity, traceability, and inspection readiness.
  • Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Safety, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality teams to support study milestones and submissions.
  • Drive risk-based data review and quality oversight activities, including metrics, issue management, and continuous process improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, 21 CFR Part 11, company SOPs, and applicable privacy requirements.
  • Support regulatory inspections, audits, and health authority submissions.
  • Develop and maintain data management SOPs, work instructions, templates, and training materials.
  • Build and lead a high-performing data management function as the company advances its clinical pipeline.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Computer Science, Biostatistics, Health Informatics, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of progressive clinical data management experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership of clinical programs and external data management vendors.
  • Strong expertise in EDC systems, database design, data review, coding, reconciliation processes, and database lock activities.
  • Working knowledge of CDISC standards, MedDRA, and WHODrug.
  • Thorough understanding of ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, data integrity principles, and clinical trial data standards.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth biotechnology environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MS, MPH, PharmD, or equivalent).
  • Certified Clinical Data Manager (CCDM) certification.
  • Experience supporting biologics, cell therapy, regenerative medicine, cardiovascular, or rare disease programs.
  • Experience leading data management activities through regulatory submissions and inspections.
  • Experience building or scaling data management capabilities within an emerging biotech company.

Territory: Michigan

Qualified candidates must have Commercial insurance underwriting experience (with authority) and a profitability & production orientated lens along with agency management.

Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Construction Services Territory Manager, you'll market, manage and underwrite commercial line business through direct contact with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through developing, negotiating and executing business plans. Collaboration with all internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence will be key to success.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and other factors necessary to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes plans to resolve those situations.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions.   • Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines.   • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, and improve agency relationship. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities.   • Proven ability to manage a significant workload effectively and back up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial line business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:
