Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

raw.description:
ABOUT POWER FACTORS

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an HMI Schematics Designer on our SCADA Delivery team, you will design and update HMI schematics for the Unity SCADA platform. You’ll work from Technical Manager (TM) inputs and client-specific templates, making sure every schematic is accurate, consistent with client requirements, and delivered on time from first draft through final client approval.

What you’ll do

Ticket management

  • Review and manage HMI schematics creation tickets submitted to the USIB Jira board by Technical Managers and Project Managers
  • Verify tickets are complete: project type (PV, BESS, Hybrid), provisioning portal, client, applicable template, and any specific requirements
  • Track tickets through the USIB Jira board stages

Input collection and coordination

  • Gather the inputs needed to build schematics screens, such as SLDs and client-specific requests
  • Work with TMs, PMs, and clients to resolve missing or unclear inputs before design begins

Schematics creation, review, and approval

  • Create Unity SCADA HMI schematics from the provided inputs, client templates, and project requirements
  • Review completed schematics internally and make any needed fixes
  • Send schematics to the client for review and address comments until final approval
  • Upload approved schematics to all required portals, including cloud and local instances provided to the client

Change requests and Unity Portal updates

  • Review change requests from TMs and PMs on the USIB Jira board and implement the specified updates or corrections
  • Review Unity Portal updates communicated by TMs and PMs to confirm schematics screens still operate correctly

AI-assisted engineering

  • Use AI tools to speed up schematics design and review, and validate outputs for accuracy, completeness, and compliance before client delivery
  • Use AI tools to check adherence to client-specific templates and standards, and help improve design quality and consistency over time

REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience (or strong interest) in HMI/SCADA schematics design [add years of experience for the level you’re hiring]
  • Familiarity with PV, BESS, and/or Hybrid project types [adjust by level]
  • Ability to read and work from single-line diagrams (SLDs) and client templates
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and template consistency
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including writing client-facing comments and change notes
  • Comfort working in Jira-based ticket workflows
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders (TMs, PMs, clients) and chase down missing information
  • Willingness to use AI tools in your daily engineering work and to check their output carefully
  • Nice to have: experience with Unity SCADA

LIFE @ POWER FACTORS

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

WHY JOIN US

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!
THE COMPANY
Blended Technologies is bringing modern SaaS to the wine industry. Our products will give winemakers the tools to manage all aspects of the winemaking process from grape to bottle, and will allow winery owners to optimize their business with tailored workflows, inventory tracking, tasting room management, direct-to-consumer sales, and CRM. We help owners and winemakers spend less time on tax and compliance paperwork and more time making great wine and keeping customers happy.
We are a fully-funded seed-stage startup rounding out our initial engineering team that is conceiving, designing, building, and bringing our product to market. We are offering competitive salary and benefits as well as single-digit-employee-number equity.
THE ROLE
Being one of the first engineering hires at a startup is a special thing – you’ll never have a greater impact, you’ll never have more opportunity, you’ll never get a bigger piece of the pie, and you’ll never have more fun. This position reports directly to an experienced CTO with decades of experience at Google, Netflix, Apple, Twilio and other tech-focused companies.
We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to help design and build our service from the ground up. You should have built big things before, have opinions about what works and what doesn’t, and can work independently on even bigger things. There isn’t always going to be a clear map that explains how to get where we want to go, so you should be comfortable trying to understand our customer needs really well, be given some UI sketches, a data schema, and coworkers to collaborate with, and be excited to figure out the rest from there.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience at 2-3+ tech-focused companies
  • Expert knowledge of React/TypeScript
  • Expert knowledge of HTML/CSS
  • Solid grasp of UX design fundamentals and the ability to translate an idea into reasonable basic UI

The more experience with any/all of these, the better:

  • GraphQL
  • Chakra or another UI component toolkit
  • React Native
  • Solid knowledge of HTTP protocol
  • Even more UX design skills than mentioned above
  • Writing GraphQL resolvers on the backend
  • MongoDB
  • AWS Cognito/Lambda/DocumentDB/API Gateway/CloudFormation
  • Writing good technical documentation
  • Working knowledge of managed cloud-service software development, esp. AWS
  • Working knowledge of building software in containerized deployments, with full CI/CD
  • A passion for leading and mentoring engineers
  • A desire to work directly with customers (winemaker customer visits are pretty great)

Job Description:

Risk Supervisor


About the Role

Constellation Payments is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Risk Supervisor to lead the day-to-day operations of the Risk team, including merchant risk monitoring, transaction review, bank account change controls, and ongoing portfolio risk oversight. This role is responsible for overseeing the identification, investigation, escalation, and mitigation of emerging fraud, compliance, transaction, chargeback, ACH, NACHA, website, MCC, and merchant behavior risks across both new and existing merchants.

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities, workloads, risk trends, and business needs continuously evolve. They are comfortable balancing operational oversight, team development, escalated case management, and strategic risk initiatives while ensuring service levels, quality standards, and risk controls are consistently maintained.

The Risk Supervisor will work closely with Risk leadership, Underwriting, Onboarding, Merchant Support, Finance, Compliance, Product, and external partners to ensure risk items are appropriately reviewed, documented, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner. This role plays a critical part in strengthening post-boarding controls, protecting the merchant portfolio, supporting regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement across risk operations.

This position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing organization by leading risk operations, developing team capabilities, enhancing monitoring frameworks, improving operational controls, and supporting strategic business initiatives.


What You'll Do

  • Lead and oversee the daily activities of the Risk team, ensuring risk queues, investigations, alerts, reviews, and escalations are completed accurately and within established service levels.
  • Supervise merchant risk monitoring activities related to fraud, compliance, reputational, operational, ACH, chargeback, and transaction-related risks.
  • Review and approve escalated investigations involving held transactions, large ticket activity, excessive refunds, duplicate transactions, excessive authorizations, excessive declines, ACH returns, suspicious merchant behavior, and emerging risk trends.
  • Manage team workload, priorities, queue assignments, and resource allocation to ensure timely completion of all risk reviews and investigations.
  • Conduct regular quality assurance reviews of risk cases, documentation, merchant outreach, escalations, workflows, and monitoring activities.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, training, and performance feedback to Risk Analysts while supporting career development and skill growth.
  • Oversee bank account change controls, ensuring validations, approvals, quality reviews, system updates, and post-change monitoring activities are completed according to policy.
  • Ensure ongoing merchant monitoring programs are implemented and performed on a regular, and cadence-based approach
  • Support enhanced due diligence reviews and monitoring activities for high-risk industries, MCCs, NEC classifications, firearms and ammunition merchants, non-profits, and other restricted business categories.
  • Oversee chargeback, ACH, and NACHA monitoring programs, including threshold monitoring, return rate reviews, recurring payment analysis, remediation efforts, and risk trend management.
  • Review and approve risk assessments, recommendations, merchant restrictions, monitoring plans, escalation decisions, and account actions.
  • Ensure periodic KYC/KYB refreshes, merchant portfolio reviews, and documentation validation activities are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Prepare and deliver recurring risk reporting, KPI dashboards, operational updates, portfolio analysis, escalation summaries, and trend reporting for leadership.
  • Identify emerging risks, operational gaps, control weaknesses, and process improvement opportunities while implementing corrective actions and monitoring effectiveness.
  • Partner closely with Underwriting, Compliance, Product, Finance, Onboarding, Merchant Support, and partner-facing teams to resolve complex issues and improve workflows.
  • Support audits, compliance reviews, sponsor bank requests, processor inquiries, and operational examinations.
  • Assist with policy development, procedure documentation, workflow enhancements, risk framework expansion, and strategic operational initiatives.
  • Operate effectively in a rapidly changing environment, adapting risk controls, processes, priorities, and team responsibilities as business needs evolve.
  • Take ownership of leadership initiatives, special projects, and additional responsibilities assigned by management.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in risk operations, payments, fraud prevention, underwriting, compliance operations, banking operations, or related fields.
  • 1-3 years of leadership, team lead, supervisory, or management experience.
  • Required to travel up to 15% annually for company meetings, leadership events, partner engagements, training, conferences, and other business-related activities as required.
  • Strong understanding of payment processing, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, chargebacks, ACH processing, NACHA rules, fraud prevention, and operational risk management.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, prioritize workloads, manage escalations, and drive operational performance.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills with the ability to assess complex risk scenarios and provide clear recommendations.
  • Experience building procedures, monitoring programs, controls, scorecards, dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, investigations, escalations, and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high-quality standards across team output.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Risk, Compliance, Underwriting, Operations, Product, Finance, and external partners.
  • Working knowledge of ACH processing, NACHA Operating Rules, ACH return thresholds, and payments risk management best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in merchant acquiring, PayFac operations, fintech, payment risk, card-not-present environments, or payment gateway operations.
  • Experience leading risk monitoring, fraud prevention, underwriting, compliance, or operational support teams.
  • Familiarity with Payrix, Salesforce, Zift, Vantiv IQ, LegitScript, GIACT, Inscribe, or similar risk and verification platforms.
  • Experience developing KPIs, SLAs, quality assurance programs, operational reporting, and team performance metrics.
  • Experience supporting audits, sponsor bank reviews, regulatory examinations, and compliance initiatives.
  • Knowledge of MCC governance, high-risk verticals, prohibited merchant categories, and enhanced due diligence requirements.
  • Experience designing and implementing risk controls, monitoring frameworks, escalation procedures, and operational workflows.
  • Experience working with ACH risk monitoring programs, NACHA compliance requirements, return rate management, and payment network rules.
  • Experience with risky business verticals and building monitoring around them.

Key Success Measures

  • Risk queues, alerts, escalations, investigations, and reviews are completed within established service levels.
  • Team productivity, quality, accuracy, and documentation standards are consistently maintained.
  • High-risk cases and emerging threats are identified, escalated, and addressed proactively.
  • Bank account change controls and post-change monitoring processes are effective and compliant.
  • Risk reporting provides meaningful insights, actionable recommendations, and visibility into operational performance.
  • Team members receive regular coaching, development, and performance support.
  • Audit findings, quality reviews, and compliance issues are minimized through strong controls and oversight.
  • Operational processes continuously improve through effective leadership, monitoring, and risk management practices.
  • Merchant payment activity, including ACH, card processing, chargebacks, return rates, and compliance thresholds, is actively monitored with timely remediation, escalation, and risk mitigation as needed.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.description:
Senior Account Manager, Customer Success

Full-Time, Remote / Salary, Exempt / Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno is growing! We're looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our Customer Success team, the people who make sure every law firm we partner with feels like they're in the best possible hands. You'll be the go-to person for your AmLaw firms, the one they trust to get it right, and the glue between our clients, Account Executives, and the teams behind every deposition. We're a diverse team from all over the country (and beyond) and we're crazy about redefining the boundaries of an outdated industry.

Who are you?

You're the person clients are relieved to hear from. You remember that one firm wants the exhibits sent a certain way and that another always needs things yesterday, and you handle both without breaking a sweat. You're detail-obsessed, calm when a deposition is on the line, and happiest when you've spotted a problem before anyone else knew it existed. You like owning things through to the finish, you love building real relationships, and you know how to balance a busy inbox with the bigger picture. In this role, you'll be both a trusted relationship owner and an operational partner, working side by side with Account Executives, Scheduling, Operations, Production, and Billing. This role reports to the Customer Success leadership team.

If you're looking for a company that offers support, guidance, an abundance of killer giphys, and unlimited potential to grow into your best self, you can bet we'd love to have you too.

On a regular basis you will

  • Be the primary day-to-day contact for your assigned AmLaw firms, delivering white-glove, personalized service shaped around each firm's preferences and workflows
  • Partner with Account Executives to stay aligned on account priorities, client concerns, and opportunities to grow and improve the relationship
  • Review and coordinate deposition orders through daily quality checks, making sure jobs are entered accurately and tied to the right firm and location
  • Triage scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation requests, routing them to the right teams and following through until they're done
  • Spot urgent and expedited requests, communicate the urgency clearly, and rally internal teams to meet client deadlines
  • Own first-line issue resolution, managing tickets with clear documentation, prioritization, and follow-up, and escalating high-impact issues to the right people
  • De-escalate tough conversations with empathy and professionalism, then confirm the fix landed and the client is happy
  • Keep clients informed with proactive updates and get ahead of questions before they become concerns
  • Share what you're seeing, from recurring errors and ticket trends to shifts in client sentiment, with AEs and leadership, and help fix root causes
  • Educate clients on Steno's products, services, and best practices, and flag opportunities for firms to get even more from our technology
  • Pitch in on scheduling inboxes and ticket queues during high-volume periods, and join our after-hours coverage rotation for urgent, last-minute deposition needs

You're gonna crush it if

  • You have 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or customer service in the legal industry
  • You have a client-first mindset and a track record of delivering responsive, dependable, high-touch service
  • You're known for your attention to detail and can catch discrepancies in job details, firm and location assignments, scheduling information, and documented preferences
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in writing and by phone, including through difficult conversations
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing competing deadlines and urgent requests without dropping the ball
  • You think critically, dig into root causes, and know when to escalate
  • You're comfortable moving between multiple platforms and using data to spot trends and make decisions
  • You take ownership, hand off cleanly, and see issues through to resolution
  • You're adaptable, collaborative, and energized by a changing workload
  • You're available to participate in after-hours coverage when needed
  • You're available to work core business hours in the Central timezone

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay - $85,000-$95,000
  • Premium Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage – options for you and your family, with 100% of premiums covered for some plans – well above industry benchmarks
  • Wellness/Mental Health - shared benefits to be used among employees and families
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - allowing employees to find balance in their lives
  • Options of Equity - we know our success is nothing without our team
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • A home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

  • Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .
  • Steno personnel will always have either a steno.com email address or will contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Act with caution if asked for personal information. Background checks, for example, are only conducted after an offer is extended.
  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information that may be included on a resume or application, is collected and stored in our system. Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.
  • Steno uses AI-assisted tools to help review applications and identify candidates whose experience aligns with the role. All hiring decisions are made by our People team, and a member of our team will personally reach out to candidates selected to move forward in the process.

raw.excerpt: About This RoleEvery day, WWF's conservation teams across the globe rely on robust, secure cloud infrastructure to protect wildlife, engage communities, and drive climate action.
raw.description:
About This Role

Every day, WWF's conservation teams across the globe rely on robust, secure cloud infrastructure to protect wildlife, engage communities, and drive climate action. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll be the foundational force ensuring our technology systems enable this global impact by managing mission-critical infrastructure that directly supports conservation programs.

In this position, you'll directly enable WWF-US and our network of Country Offices across South America, Central America, Africa, and Asia to operate seamlessly. Your work ensures that critical systems stay online so our teams can focus on what matters most: protecting nature at scale.

What You'll Do:

Own Our Azure Infrastructure
You'll be the architect behind WWF's Azure environment, spinning up subscriptions, provisioning resources, and building/deploying VMs (Windows, SQL, Red Hat, firewalls) from the ground up in both production and staging.

Lock Down Security & Identity
Configure Microsoft Entra tenants, manage SSO through Azure Enterprise Apps, and keep our RBAC and user groups clean and secure. You'll patch systems proactively and use PowerShell + Graph API to automate the boring stuff so the important stuff runs smoother.

Be Our Safety Net
Design backup strategies and disaster recovery playbooks that actually work when it matters. You're the reason we sleep at night knowing our systems can bounce back from anything.

Keep Everything Connected
Troubleshoot networking across VNETs, sites, and tenants. Firewalls, load balancers, DNS (Azure + Cloudflare), you speak the language fluently and fix problems before they become fires.

Be the Go-To Expert
When Azure, Entra ID, or M365 issues get complicated, you're who the team calls. You'll lead projects end-to-end and keep stakeholders, technical and non-technical alike, in the loop every step of the way.

Show Up When It Counts
Occasional after-hours or weekend work for critical outages or planned maintenance, because uptime matters, and so does the team that protects it.

Key Competencies

  • Ability to Multitask. Demonstrates strong technical and operational agility, effectively navigating complex business and cloud environments to deliver tailored, high-quality support across WWF’s Azure and multi-cloud platforms.
  • Solution-Oriented and Strategic Collaboration. Clear, influential communicator who leads projects end-to-end, ensuring alignment, transparency, and active engagement with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Growth Mindset. Demonstrates a strong growth mindset, continually expanding expertise in evolving cloud, automation, and security technologies and applying new knowledge to strengthen WWF’s technical capabilities.
  • Big Picture Thinking. Strategic acumen complemented by robust technical proficiency
  • Collaborative. Proven ability to work effectively as part of a team
  • Project Management. Strong organizational, documentation, and project management capabilities, including development of comprehensive project plans

Skills and Abilities

  • Degree in IT or related field AND minimum of 8 years of work experience (including at least 6 years of experience in IT)

  • MUST HAVE Verbal and written fluency in English and Spanish

  • Experience managing large-scale enterprise IT systems

  • Extensive hands-on experience managing highly available and resilient Azure production systems.

  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, cloud architecture, cloud networking, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Windows and Linux servers

  • Proficient in managing Windows domains and Active Directory

  • Expertise in using PowerShell and Graph API for Azure management, workflow automation, and deployment orchestration

  • Familiarity with provisioning and managing access for technologies such as Fabric, Power BI, and Azure Foundry

  • Experience integrating Microsoft Copilot for M365, Copilot Studio, and Copilot Agents into enterprise Azure/M365 environments, including configuration and governance of data access controls

  • Significant expertise in building, deploying, and managing virtual machines in Azure from inception

  • History of applying structured thinking to diagnose complex cloud or hybrid system issues and develop scalable, sustainable solutions.

  • Well-honed methodologies for diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues.

  • Broad enterprise scale expertise across infrastructure, Azure cloud architecture, identity and access management with Entra ID, and emerging AI‑ driven‑ automation technologies—enabling the evaluation and recommendation of modernization opportunities, security improvements, and strategic technology replacements. skills in configuring Microsoft Entra tenants and domains, including DNS and VNET setup.

  • Committed to building and strengthening a culture of inclusion within and across teams.

  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:

    • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.

    • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.

    • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.

    • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

Please note: Candidates must be currently based and authorized to work in one of the following countries to be eligible for this position: Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, or Guyana.

Remuneration: Salary and benefits for this position will be paid in local currency.

Application instructions: Resumes and cover letters must be submitted in English to be considered for this position

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the job's location. Position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Founded in 1961, WWF works to help people and nature thrive. As a global conservation organization, WWF operates in more than 100 countries, partnering with communities, companies, and governments to protect wildlife, conserve vital habitats, and advance sustainable solutions. Grounded in science and driven by collaboration, WWF works to help nature by conserving biodiversity, supporting resilient communities, and addressing climate change. Nearly 1 million people in the United States and more than 5 million globally are WWF members.

raw.title: VP of Economic & Community Development
raw.excerpt: At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
raw.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build, we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

Position Overview:

The Vice President, Economic & Community Development is responsible for building and leading Montera's economic development, community engagement, and government relations function as the company expands its hyperscale data center development platform across the United States.

Reporting directly to the Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer within the External Affairs department, this role will serve as Montera's primary representative for government relations across its development markets. The position will oversee state and local economic development agreements, community outreach, legislative and regulatory engagement, organized labor relationships, and the external partnerships necessary to support successful project development.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience navigating state and local government, negotiating complex economic development and incentive agreements, and building community engagement strategies for large-scale infrastructure projects. Success in this role means establishing trusted relationships with government officials, community stakeholders, economic development organizations, and industry partners while identifying and mitigating political, regulatory, and community risks throughout the development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys building functions, processes, and relationships from the ground up while representing a rapidly growing infrastructure developer in complex and highly visible development markets.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables:

Government Relations & Public Affairs

  • Lead Montera's government relations strategy across existing and prospective development markets, serving as the primary point of contact for state and local government affairs.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of legislative priorities, regulatory environments, political dynamics, and government decision-making processes in each market Montera enters or evaluates.
  • Build and maintain relationships with elected officials, government agencies, county commissions, planning and zoning authorities, economic development organizations, and other public-sector stakeholders.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments that could impact site selection, project development, infrastructure investment, or long-term operations.
  • Develop strategies for engaging government stakeholders early in the development lifecycle to support project feasibility, regulatory alignment, and successful execution.
  • Represent Montera at legislative forums, government meetings, public hearings, and other venues requiring senior-level company representation.

Economic Development Agreements & Incentive Negotiations

  • Lead the evaluation, structuring, and negotiation of state and local economic development agreements supporting Montera's hyperscale data center developments.
  • Conduct diligence on available economic development incentives, tax structures, and public-sector programs that may influence project economics or development feasibility.
  • Partner with Site Selection, Development, Finance, and Legal teams to evaluate incentive opportunities, negotiate commercial terms, and establish appropriate contractual protections.
  • Develop relationships with state and local economic development organizations to identify investment opportunities and support development negotiations.
  • Assess the financial, regulatory, and operational implications of proposed incentive packages, tax arrangements, and government agreements.
  • Oversee ongoing compliance considerations and stakeholder commitments associated with economic development agreements.

Community Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

  • Develop and lead Montera's community outreach and engagement strategy across its development markets, beginning with initial land positions and continuing through construction and long-term operations.
  • Build trusted relationships with local communities, civic organizations, business leaders, public officials, and other stakeholders impacted by large-scale infrastructure development.
  • Establish communication and engagement programs that proactively address community priorities, project concerns, and potential development impacts.
  • Represent Montera at community meetings, public hearings, industry events, and stakeholder forums, communicating project benefits, commitments, and development plans.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure community considerations are integrated into site selection, entitlement, permitting, construction planning, and operational activities.
  • Develop community engagement approaches that align with hyperscale customer expectations, including relevant community standards and commitments established by companies such as Microsoft, Google, and Meta.

Labor Relations & Workforce Development

  • Build and maintain relationships with organized labor, local building trades councils, unions, workforce development organizations, and apprenticeship programs.
  • Develop Montera's strategy for engaging organized labor and supporting workforce commitments across its development markets.
  • Partner with Development, Delivery, Legal, and other internal stakeholders to evaluate project labor agreements and related workforce considerations.
  • Support negotiations and stakeholder engagement related to local-hire commitments, workforce development initiatives, and construction labor requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen community relationships through workforce investment, local employment, and apprenticeship partnerships.
  • Ensure labor and workforce strategies support entitlement objectives, community goodwill, construction readiness, and long-term project success.

Development Pipeline Risk & Market Intelligence

  • Provide early identification and assessment of political, regulatory, community, and stakeholder risks that could affect development opportunities.
  • Develop local market intelligence networks capable of identifying emerging issues and opportunities beyond publicly available information.
  • Partner with Site Selection and Development teams to evaluate the government relations and community implications of prospective sites and target markets.
  • Assess local attitudes toward data center development, infrastructure investment, land use, utilities, taxation, and construction activities.
  • Deliver actionable market intelligence and recommendations to executive leadership to support site prioritization, investment decisions, and development risk mitigation.
  • Maintain visibility into government and community commitments that could affect development schedules, project costs, or long-term operating requirements.

External Partner Management & Function Development

  • Build and scale Montera's economic and community development function, establishing the processes, tools, and external partnerships necessary to support a growing national development portfolio.
  • Select, manage, and hold accountable external lobbyists, government affairs consultants, community engagement advisors, and other specialized partners across development markets.
  • Establish consistent stakeholder mapping, relationship management, reporting standards, and operating rhythms across the function.
  • Develop repeatable government relations and community engagement playbooks that can be adapted to different markets, jurisdictions, and project requirements.
  • Provide executive leadership with visibility into government relations activities, economic development negotiations, community engagement efforts, and emerging development risks.
  • Collaborate with Development, Delivery, Legal, Finance, Commercial, and executive leadership to align external affairs strategies with broader organizational priorities.
  • Foster a proactive, relationship-driven approach to economic development and community engagement that supports Montera's long-term growth and reputation.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Public Administration, Political Science, Urban Planning, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in economic development, government relations, public affairs, site-selection advisory, or a related function.
  • Extensive experience negotiating large-scale economic development agreements, incentive packages, and related government agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge of state and local tax considerations, incentive structures, and the legal agreements associated with economic development projects.
  • Demonstrated understanding of state and local government operations, including economic development organizations, county commissions, planning and zoning authorities, utility regulators, and state legislatures.
  • Experience developing and executing community engagement strategies for large-scale industrial, energy, infrastructure, or comparable development projects.
  • Experience managing external lobbyists, consultants, and government affairs partners across multiple jurisdictions or development markets.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging organized labor, building trades, or workforce development stakeholders in a construction or infrastructure environment.
  • Familiarity with project labor agreements, local-hire commitments, workforce development programs, and apprenticeship initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence, stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to represent an organization effectively in public hearings, legislative forums, and community settings.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting complex issues to public officials, executive leadership, and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience building processes, managing competing priorities, and operating independently in a fast-paced or evolving organizational environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the United States to support government relations, economic development negotiations, and community engagement activities.

Preferred Skills:

  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale data center development, particularly economic development agreements, government relations, or community engagement.
  • Professional background beginning in local or state economic development, followed by experience in a corporate or private-sector development environment.
  • Experience negotiating incentive agreements for large-scale industrial, energy, digital infrastructure, or other capital-intensive development projects.
  • Established relationships with economic development organizations, government officials, industry associations, and community stakeholders in major U.S. development markets.
  • Familiarity with hyperscale customer community engagement expectations, including programs such as Microsoft's Good Neighbor commitments.
  • Experience developing community benefit initiatives, local workforce partnerships, or other stakeholder commitments supporting infrastructure development.
  • Certified Economic Developer (CEcD) designation through the International Economic Development Council (IEDC) or a comparable professional credential.
  • Experience establishing government affairs, economic development, or community engagement functions within a growing organization.
  • Ability to identify political, regulatory, and community risks early and translate market intelligence into actionable development recommendations.
  • A hands-on, relationship-driven leadership style and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments while maintaining strong commercial judgment.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

  • Remote Work: Montera operates as a remote-first company. Employees are expected to maintain a professional, reliable remote work setup and appropriate availability during working hours.
  • Travel Requirements: Regular domestic travel is required to support government relations, economic development negotiations, community engagement, public meetings, and company activities across Montera's development markets.
  • Physical Demands: This role primarily involves standard office and computer-based work, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, public presentations, and periodic visits to active development and construction sites.
  • Montera will provide reasonable accommodations to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role, consistent with applicable law.

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you'll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We're a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

This position offers the opportunity to establish and lead a dedicated economic and community development function within a rapidly growing hyperscale data center platform. Rather than joining an established government affairs organization with narrowly defined responsibilities, you'll work directly with the Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer to build Montera's strategy, relationships, and operating framework across existing and emerging development markets.

You'll have direct influence over how Montera engages state and local governments, negotiates economic development agreements, establishes community partnerships, and creates lasting economic value in the communities where it operates.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable base salary range for this role is $250,000–$275,000 annually, plus an annual performance-based bonus.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences, and professional development opportunities.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you'll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Bookkeeper

Compensation range: $1,500 AUD - $2,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an award-winning Australian accounting firm with offices across major Australian cities. They offer a range of services, including tax, accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, business advisory, SMSF, and virtual CFO services, with specialist expertise in healthcare, construction, and e-commerce. Known for their personalised approach and supportive team culture, they prioritise strong client relationships and quality service.

Role Overview: Join a growing bookkeeping team managing a portfolio of Australian small business clients. You’ll maintain accurate financial records, process payroll on time, and communicate directly with clients to keep their accounts running smoothly. This role offers the opportunity to develop your skills and build a long-term career with a supportive Australian firm.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process transactions and reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts accurately.
  • Code transactions correctly for Australian GST, including GST-free items.
  • Process weekly payroll accurately and meet deadlines, including Monday payroll before 2:00 PM AEST.
  • Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for review by the accounting team.
  • Manage accounts payable and receivable, including supplier bills, invoices, and debtor follow-ups.
  • Communicate with clients to request information and clarify bookkeeping requirements.
  • Prepare month-end and quarter-end reports and maintain organised client records.
  • Document processes and client notes to support team collaboration.
  • Track time accurately against client jobs for billing purposes.

Requirements

  • Must have at least 2–3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience.
  • A solid grasp of Australian GST, including how to research and confirm whether an item is GST or GST-free.
  • Experience processing weekly payroll and meeting strict deadlines; STP and superannuation experience is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in cloud accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks Online.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain bookkeeping matters to clients in a friendly, easy-to-understand way.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation, and time management.
  • Reliable home office setup with stable internet and backup power and connectivity.
  • Experience working with Australian accounting firms or Australian small business clients.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts, particularly in healthcare, construction, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT), PAYG, and Australian payroll awards.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
Web Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development.

Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Own

Visual Design & Prototyping

  • Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins.
  • Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences.

Responsive Web Design

  • Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS.

Design System Maintenance

  • Contribute to and improve the existing design system.
  • Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts.
  • Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows.

Developer Collaboration & Handoff

  • Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions.
  • Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development.

Feedback & Iteration

  • Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions.
  • Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus.
  • Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early.

Design Quality Assurance

  • Review implemented pages against approved designs.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
  • Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS.
  • Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability.
  • Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
  • You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
  • You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
  • You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
  • You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
  • Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
  • Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.
  • Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback.
  • Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

raw.description:
This is a 12 - month contract with our client in the banking sector

Job Purpose

To design, prototype, and build next-generation analytic engines and services by applying strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Purpose

Build, deploy, scale and support machine learning, AI and GenAI solutions in production. The role focuses on operationalising models, developing AI applications and agents, and creating the platforms and services required to deliver business value at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Productionise, deploy and monitor machine learning models and data science pipelines on Databricks.
  • Build, deploy and support AI Agents, GenAI applications and RAG solutions on Databricks.
  • Develop and maintain reusable ML pipelines using MLOps principles, including CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring and governance.
  • Deploy, optimise and manage open source AI and machine learning models on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Design, develop and support custom APIs and microservices on AKS to expose AI and machine learning capabilities to business applications.
  • Implement containerised solutions using Docker and Kubernetes to ensure scalable, secure and resilient deployments.
  • Monitor model performance, drift, reliability and operational health in production environments.
  • Partner with Data Scientists to productionise prototypes and enable business-ready solutions.
  • Collaborate with platform, security, cloud and infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to models, pipelines, APIs and AI applications.
  • Optimise AI and ML solutions for performance, scalability, cost and reliability.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, reusable frameworks and best practices across the AI and ML ecosystem.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, MLOps, Databricks, Kubernetes and cloud technologies.

Core Deliverables

  • Production-ready ML models and pipelines running on Databricks.
  • AI Agents and business applications deployed on Databricks.
  • Open source LLMs and AI services deployed on AKS.
  • Secure and scalable APIs exposing AI capabilities to consuming systems.
  • Automated deployment, monitoring and governance processes.
  • Reliable, scalable and compliant AI platforms supporting business outcomes.

Key Skills

  • Databricks Workflows, Model Serving, MLflow and Mosaic AI
  • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Python, SQL and REST APIs
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • CI/CD and MLOps practices
  • Machine Learning and Generative AI
  • LLM deployment and optimisation
  • Cloud engineering and infrastructure automation
  • Monitoring, observability and troubleshooting

Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematical Statistics, Actuary Science. Masters or Doctorate will be an added advantage.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AI-102 or equivalent)
  • Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Generative AI Engineer)
  • Kubernetes and containerisation certifications (CKA, CKAD or equivalent)
  • DevOps, MLOps or Platform Engineering certifications
  • AWS or Google Cloud certifications will be advantageous
  • Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or Data Science certifications from recognised providers such as Microsoft, Databricks, SAS, Coursera or DeepLearning.AI will be an added advantage

Technical / Professional Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of MLOps, DevOps and software engineering practices for machine learning platforms.
  • Experience building, deploying and supporting machine learning solutions in production environments.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with SQL and API development.
  • Experience with Databricks, MLflow, Model Serving and cloud-native AI/ML platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker and containerised application deployment.
  • Experience deploying and supporting machine learning and Generative AI solutions on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation and platform monitoring.

raw.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry.

We collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles - from AAA titles to emerging technologies. Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it’s porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners’ internal teams. We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

  • Epic
  • Xbox
  • Meta
  • Obsidian Entertainment
  • Riot
  • Gearbox Software

We're hiring a Senior Business Development Manager who can do both halves of the job: source and close new business, and grow the accounts we already have. Reporting directly to the Head of BD, you'll be the operator who makes pipeline, retention, and account growth predictable. We are open to the seniority of the role depending on candidate experience.

This is not a hunter-handoff role. You'll stay close to your accounts after signing, partner with production when issues come up, and be the operator clients trust to tell them the truth.

It's also not a relationship-manager role. You'll have a personal lead-generation pipeline and you'll be measured on new logos sourced as well as existing accounts grown. We need both motions in one operator.

Key Responsibilities:

New business and pipeline

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities, partnerships, and strategic alliances to expand Devoted's client base.

• Build your own lead-generation pipeline — outbound, network, events — alongside developing existing relationships.

• Run the full deal cycle: discovery, scoping with production, proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Collaborate with the production team to identify and shape opportunities that play to Devoted's capabilities and expertise.

Account growth and retention

• Maintain client satisfaction at 8/10 or higher across your portfolio of clients

• Build and nurture strong relationships with clients at every level — operational, senior, and strategic.

• Support the Head of BD with account retention and management strategies for the largest accounts.

• Continuously assess and evaluate the effectiveness of business development strategies and initiatives, recommending improvements and adjustments as needed.

Client liaison and contract

• Be the client's primary point of contact when production issues come up — ensuring both parties focus on finding the best solution rather than placing blame.

• Negotiate and finalize contracts and agreements with clients, partners, and vendors to ensure favorable terms and mutually beneficial relationships.

• Support legal and finance with any questions on contracts and invoicing for current accounts.

Operating discipline

• Be an evangelist of CRM excellence: prepare weekly plans and report on current and prospective client communication.

• Prepare regular status reports including activity, closings, follow-up, and adherence to goals.

• Participate in networking events, conferences, and industry shows — represent Devoted, bring back leads and intelligence.

Requirements

• 7+ years in business development, sales, or partnerships in the games industry, with a track record of revenue ownership at the Director level.

• Platform-agnostic experience — you've sold or grown accounts across PC, console, and mobile. Not a single-platform specialist.

• Demonstrable personal lead generation: you've built outbound discipline and converted at the top of the funnel, not just managed inbound.

• Account growth track record: existing accounts that grew quarter-over-quarter under your ownership, with measurable numbers behind it.

• Real contract negotiation experience on commercial terms — pricing, scope, IP, payment terms, indemnity.

• Strong commercial fluency: you understand margin, you know what a scope change costs, and you can read a project P&L.

• CRM discipline: HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable — used as an operating tool, not a reporting chore.

• Outstanding relationship management and interpersonal skills — caring team player who engages effectively across all levels of management, staff, and clients.

• Excellent presentation, written, and spoken English — comfortable in front of senior client stakeholders and on stage at industry events.

• Strong analytical and project management skills — able to juggle multiple deals and accounts, prioritize ruthlessly, and meet tight deadlines without losing the detail.

• Genuine knowledge of and passion for video games and the broader games ecosystem — engines, platforms, business models, who's hot and who's fading.

• Calm under pressure, organized, accountable. World-class quality is the only acceptable standard.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling co-development, porting, art services, or other game services (vs. only IP licensing or publishing).

• Existing personal network across publishers, platform holders, and mid-to-large independent studios in North America and Europe.

• Experience hiring and mentoring junior BD or lead-gen staff.

• Conference circuit familiarity: GDC, Gamescom, Devcom, regional summits.

• Familiarity with advanced research tools and resources for prospecting and intelligence.

Benefits

This is a full-time employment position, benefits vary depending on whether the candidate is based in either the U.S. or Canada

The successful candidate will be a proactive problem solver who leverages out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities to deliver maintainable and business-driven solutions.

  • Support software compliance, normalization, reclamation, SaaS optimization, and asset governance initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain Service Catalog Items, Record Producers, approval workflows, and fulfillment processes.
  • Build automation solutions using Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and ServiceNow platform capabilities.
  • Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, Import Sets, and Transform Maps.

  • Develop and maintain Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Flow Designer Flows, Scheduled Jobs, and Scripted REST APIs.
  • Troubleshoot platform, integration, and automation issues through root cause analysis.
  • Support ITSM processes including Incident, Change, Problem, and Request Management.
  • Maintain CMDB data quality, asset-to-CI relationships, and support CSDM initiatives.
  • Ensure solutions adhere to ServiceNow best practices, governance standards, and technical documentation requirements.
  • .8+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
  • 5+ years of experience implementing and supporting IT Asset Management solutions.
  • Strong experience with HAM Pro, SAM Pro, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and REST API integrations.
  • Extensive experience building Catalog Items, Record Producers, and automated fulfillment workflows.
  • Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise.
  • Experience with Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Imports, and workflow automation.
  • Good understanding of ITSM processes and service delivery concepts.
  • Working knowledge of CMDB, Discovery, CSDM concepts, and Asset-to-CI relationships.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification required.

Nice to Have

  • Certified Application Developer (CAD).
  • ITIL Foundation Certification.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery and CMDB health initiatives.
  • Exposure to SaaS license optimization and software compliance programs.
  • Experience working in large enterprise ServiceNow environments.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

title: 数据开发工程师（实时计算方向）
description: 【岗位定位】 1、公司已经建立较完善的数据仓库和实时数据体系，具备数据采集、计算、存储及服务能力。随着业务规模增长和实时应用场景增加，我们希望引入两名中高级数据开发工程师，负责实时数据需求交付、任务优化及工程治理。 2、该岗位以实时数据开发为主，同时参与离线数仓建设。你将重点解决实时链路中的数据延迟、状态膨胀、资源消耗、数据质量及一致性等问题，推动实时数据体系向更稳定、更高效、更规范的方向演进。 【岗位职责】 1、负责实时数据需求的分析、方案设计和开发交付，基于Flink、Kafka等技术建设实时数据处理链路，为实时分析、监控、指标及业务决策等场景提供数据支持。 2、参与实时数仓建设及模型设计，结合业务需求完成数据分层、指标口径、维度模型和数据服务的设计与落地。 3、持续优化现有实时任务，解决数据延迟、反压、Checkpoint异常、状态膨胀、资源利用率不合理及数据不一致等问题，提升任务稳定性和计算效率。 4、参与数据治理和工程质量建设，包括任务依赖梳理、元数据管理、数据质量监控、告警机制、开发规范及问题排查体系建设。 5、参与大数据平台及计算引擎的日常维护和问题处理，协同上下游团队保障数据链路的稳定性、准确性和时效性。 6、沉淀实时开发最佳实践和技术经验，通过技术分享、代码评审及方案评审，提升团队整体实时研发能力。 【任职要求】 1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、信息技术或相关专业，具有5年及以上数据开发或大数据研发经验；能力优秀者可适当放宽。 2、具备完整的数据仓库项目经验，熟悉实时数仓架构、数据分层和数据模型设计，能够将业务需求转化为数据模型及技术方案。 3、熟练掌握Flink，具有Flink SQL、DataStream API等实际项目经验，理解State、Checkpoint、Watermark、窗口、反压和容错机制。 4、具备实时任务开发及优化经验，能够独立分析和解决任务延迟、资源消耗较高、状态异常、数据倾斜及数据一致性等问题。 5、熟悉Kafka及实时数据链路，理解数据采集、传输、计算、存储和服务的完整流程。 6、熟悉Hadoop、Hive、Spark等大数据技术，具备一定的离线数据开发能力。 7、熟练掌握SQL，能够完成复杂数据加工和性能优化；至少熟悉Python、Java或Scala中的一种开发语言。 8、熟悉MySQL、PostgreSQL、Elasticsearch等常用数据库或存储系统。 9、具备良好的业务理解、沟通协作和书面表达能力，责任心强，能够主动推动问题解决和项目落地。 【加分项】 1、具有大规模Flink任务开发、性能调优或集群治理经验。 2、具有实时数仓架构优化、实时链路治理或技术升级经验。 3、熟悉Hologres、ClickHouse、Doris等实时OLAP技术。 4、具有实时指标、实时监控、实时风控、实时推荐等复杂业务场景经验。 【我们期待的候选人】 1、我们希望你不仅能够完成数据需求开发，也愿意深入理解实时计算机制，关注数据链路的稳定性、性能和工程质量。 2、面对复杂问题，你能够从数据、代码、任务配置和运行机制等多个角度定位原因，并将解决方案沉淀为可复用的规范、工具或最佳实践。
