Associate Director, Art Direction

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a talented and strategic Associate Director, Art Direction to join a fast-paced, high-performing team supporting one of our most visible, dynamic clients. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table.

As a key leader within the creative department, you will not only translate strategy into smart, engaging creative but also mentor a multidisciplinary team of designers and creators. You’ll partner closely with Copywriters, Video Editors, and Content Creators, reporting to the Creative Director to ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream, managing junior talent, and consistently raising the creative bar.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

.WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Deliver High-Impact Creative: Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social, and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.
  • Mentor & Lead: Act as a direct supervisor and mentor to junior and mid-level Art Directors and Designers. Provide clear, constructive feedback to creatives across disciplines (for example, to copy) to elevate the team's output and foster professional growth.
  • Support Video + Content Production: Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.
  • Partner Across Disciplines: Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.
  • Be a Problem Solver: Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.
  • Cultivate Culture: Foster an inclusive, high-energy environment. Lead daily brainstorms and inspiration-sharing sessions to keep the team’s creative pulse sharp.Manage Creative Execution: Own the work from end to end. Concepting and producing polished on-brand, performance-minded assets that meet timelines and briefs. As an Associate Director, Art Direction, you will lead by doing, driving execution while strategically delegating portions of our projects to our junior team members to support efficiency, mentorship and delivery while remaining accountable for the final output.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 5+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.
  • Prior social agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.
  • On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.
  • Generative AI Mastery: Proven hands-on experience utilizing advanced generative AI platforms (including Midjourney, Runway, Vizcom, Weavy, or equivalent visual AI tools) to conceptualize, iterate, and scale creative production workflows.
  • Performance-Driven Creative Execution: Deep understanding of paid media ecosystems, conversion design, and data-backed creative strategies. Responsible for translating high-level marketing briefs into high-volume, scroll-stopping digital assets.
  • Multi-Channel Social Optimization: Strong track record in developing native short-form video content and paid ads tailored, optimizing assets for user engagement and platform algorithm performance.
  • Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.
  • Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.
  • A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401K plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

The anticipated salary range for this position is listed below. Salary is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, expertise, physical location, and organizational impact. This is based on a 40-hour workweek and leveling. Keep in mind, we’re flexible.

US Remote Range
$122,000—$160,000 USD

Senior Product Manager, Digital Product

Department: Digital

Reports to: VP of Digital

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote, United States (East Coast preferred)

Pay Range: $130k-$160k, commensurate with experience

Margaux is a new kind of footwear brand rooted in friendship, collaboration, and community. Co-founders Sarah Pierson and Alexa Buckley launched Margaux in 2015, setting out to create a modern footwear wardrobe for women on the go, powered by thoughtful design and an innovative approach. Each pair is designed in New York and handmade in Spain, and thoughtfully crafted to withstand the test of time.

Position Overview

Reporting to the VP of Digital, you will guide our day-to-day site operator and work alongside our development, platform and app partners, supporting four businesses — DTC, wholesale, marketplace and retail — that share one digital backbone. This is a foundation-building role: much of the structure is still taking shape, and your first year will be about helping put it in place.

Responsibilities

  • Build high-caliber site capabilities and customer-facing interactions that elevate overall user engagement.
  • Track emerging tech trends and e-commerce innovation to spot new feature opportunities for the brand.
  • Evaluate potential site updates, balancing technical effort against revenue and commercial impact.
  • Turn high-priority roadmap concepts into polished, user-centric site enhancements.
  • Track performance metrics against target KPIs, establishing ongoing site optimizations based on quantitative data.
  • Maintain standard operating procedures across full feature rollouts, from initial scoping to site deployment.
  • Partner with cross-functional operations leads to streamline team workflows, align on organizational targets, and support internal growth.
  • Define and execute product strategy, requirement definitions, and release schedules aligned with overall business goals.
  • Oversee compliance and accessibility identifying the proper process and partners to support
  • Support and develop the day-to-day site operations, and manage agency and vendor relationships — scope, SLAs, budget and performance.

Qualifications

  • Proven ability to collaborate strategically with cross-functional partners to achieve shared business outcomes
  • A passion for digital brand experience and the customer journey
  • Deep, hands-on Shopify Plus experience (or a comparable enterprise platform) — themes, apps and integrations.
  • Owned onsite merchandising through seasonal launches and promotional periods, balancing commercial targets against brand and customer experience.
  • A real CRO track record, backed by fluency in the stack that supports it.
  • Directed internal or agency developers from business requirements through QA and release.
  • Brought order to an unstructured request environment — an intake or prioritization process that enabled scale.
  • Ability to set clear objectives and design strategies that inspire and align the team
  • Deep understanding and commitment to the industry, staying informed about best practices and trends in both tech and retail

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off so you can rest and recharge, as well as paid sick leave
  • Employee discount on all Margaux products
  • A close-knit, mission-driven team culture

raw.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 97.8 million monthly active users (MAU), as of March 31, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI Native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360's IT team exists to enable our 500+ remote-first employees to be equipped, productive, and secure, wherever they're working from. That means owning the identity, endpoint, infrastructure, and collaboration experience end to end, and treating the services it owns as a product. IT reports to our CISO and sits right next to Information Security, and the two teams work as true partners with decisions made together, not thrown over a wall. That partnership matters even more as Life360 leans further into an AI Native way of working: shaping what that looks like day to day means working closely with other key partners like People, Finance, and Legal, not building in isolation.

About the Job

We're hiring a Director of IT to own IT Operations and IT Engineering end to end; enterprise identity, endpoint management, corporate infrastructure, collaboration tooling, and the service model our distributed workforce depends on. This opportunity will allow you to reimagine how IT operates in an AI Native environment and bring an engineering mindset to how the function runs: structured, automated, and metrics-driven. This is a role for someone who wants to take an IT function to its next stage of maturity, not just keep it running as-is. You’ll have the agency and runway to set the strategy, build the playbooks, and lead the team to the next level.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who has scaled IT operations and engineering in high growth environments, carries strong engineering principles, and can operate with a safety first mindset.

A year in, this function is a genuine strategic partner across the business — anticipating technology and infrastructure needs and building the roadmaps that mature alongside Life360's growth. Employees experience IT as a real productivity advantage: fast, reliable tools and a technical experience they're glad to have. Every request is handled quickly, cleanly, and with real care. The budget is well-managed and forecasted with confidence. AI tooling and automation are woven into how the team operates, creating capacity for high-value, forward-looking work. IT's operational excellence also strengthens Life360's security and compliance posture, with clean identity management, strong asset visibility, and access controls that hold up confidently under audit. And the team is one people are proud to be part of; strong morale, strong retention, and a genuine draw for top IT talent who want to do their best work.

The US-based salary range for this position is $167,000 to $245,000. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and execution of Life360's core IT Operations & Engineering teams including enterprise identity, endpoint management, network infrastructure, collaboration, and end user services
  • Drive the technical roadmap and transparency programs to provide leadership clear visibility into IT quality, risks, and investments
  • Lead, hire, and grow a high-performing IT team, raising the bar toward an engineering first skillset and standing up new IT engineering roles as the function scales
  • Set and hold high quality service level standards through evolving IT's operating model: service ownership, response times, availability, and an exceptional employee experience
  • Partner with the CISO and Information Security to ensure every service and process meets our safety standards
  • Identify and implement AI Native tools and automation that improve internal productivity and employee workflows, in line with Life360's broader AI Native transformation
  • Own IT vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and budget planning, partnering with Finance and Procurement
  • Serve as escalation point and executive sponsor for major IT incidents, migrations, and large-scale initiatives

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in IT, including at least 7-8 years in a senior leadership role directing multiple teams or functions
  • Deep hands-on grounding in modern IT infrastructure: identity and access management, endpoint management, cloud collaboration platforms, and enterprise networking
  • Experience embedding AI tools and automation into IT operations and employee productivity workflows
  • Demonstrated security-first judgment partnering with Security and Compliance teams
  • Experience owning budgets, vendor relationships, and procurement decisions
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with non-technical teams
  • Comfortable operating in a global, high-growth environment where systems and headcount scale quickly
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading IT or corporate engineering at a remote-first or high-growth technology company, with a modern cloud-based stack (e.g., Okta, Jamf, and SaaS collaboration tooling) rather than a traditional on-premise environment
  • Hands-on experience building or deploying AI agents and automation into IT or employee workflows, with concrete use cases and measurable impact

Our Benefits

  • Competitive pay and benefits
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Flexible PTO, 13 company-wide days off throughout the year
  • Winter and Summer Weeklong Synchronized Company Shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership for your preferred circle
  • Free Tile Products

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

What We Do

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

Role Overview

The Product Auditor provides independent assurance over the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of product controls across payment, wallet, settlement, switches and other related products across the organisation

The role ensures that new and existing products are deployed with adequate financial, operational, security, and regulatory controls, safeguarding the organization against revenue leakage, settlement failures, regulatory breaches, and technology-driven risks.

The Product Auditor will independently evaluate product risk exposure and control maturity prior to scale.

Key Responsibilities

Audit Universe & Risk-Based Planning

  • Maintain a living Product Audit Universe covering all payment products, features, and integrations ranked by risk.
  • Own the annual Product Audit Plan, ensuring coverage is allocated dynamically based on risk ratings, product complexity, regulatory sensitivity, and change velocity.

Product Design & Control Assurance

  • Review PRDs, business rules, and transaction workflows to identify logic gaps, unmitigated risk paths, and missing exception-handling routines before products reach production/go-live.
  • Analyse product path scenarios, verify Maker-Checker enforcement, and provide formal control design sign-off before any material release goes live.

Live Product Assessment ( Continuous Audit Review)

  • Periodically assess live payment products to confirm they continue to operate within approved design parameters.
  • Detect configuration drift, identify silent divergence from original PRDs, and analyse live transaction data for emerging risk patterns.

Go-Live Readiness & Control Gate

  • Execute mandatory pre-production Product Audit reviews as an independent control gate for all material releases.
  • Confirm reconciliation logic, exception queues, and fallback controls are tested and functional.
  • Escalate critical deficiencies with risk ratings and hold recommendations where a product is not safe to release.

Transaction Logic & Mathematical Integrity

  • Interrogate the Fee Engine using SQL to mathematically prove that commissions, VAT, discounts, and splits are posted with complete precision.
  • Validate duplicate prevention mechanisms and ensure transaction integrity within complex, multi-step payment sequences, and test reversal, refund, and chargeback logic to confirm financial symmetry is maintained in every scenario.

Settlement & Ledger Integrity

  • Trace fund flows, confirming continuous synchronisation between wallet sub-ledgers and the General Ledger.
  • Assess reconciliation logic for breaks and evaluate the authorisation, documentation, and reversibility of manual settlement overrides.

Product Change & Configuration Integrity

  • Confirm that all product modifications: fee tables, routing rules, limit parameters passed through an approved change management cycle.
  • Identify silent changes made outside formal release processes and audit the integrity of product master data to ensure it is access-controlled, version-tracked, and consistent with approved product terms.

Vendor & Third-Party Product Risk

  • Assess controls over vendor-managed product components, evaluate SLA performance against contractual commitments, and identify single-vendor dependency risks within critical payment flows.
  • Evaluate the organisation's ability to detect unilateral changes in third-party API behaviour, fee logic, or settlement processes.

Control Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage product and engineering teams early in the design cycle to provide informal control advisory, reducing findings at the formal review stage without compromising independence.
  • Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, and build a control-by-design culture across product teams.

Incident Review, RCA & Regulatory Alignment

  • Lead post-incident reviews for product failures,producing structured RCA reports that identify underlying logic failures, not just surface symptoms.
  • Assess corrective actions for adequacy and track findings to verify closure.
  • Ensure product logic complies with CBN guidelines, PCI DSS, and consumer protection obligations at the design level, and evaluate the regulatory impact of new features before release.

Reporting & Governance

  • Prepare risk-rated audit reports for Executive Management and the Audit Committee, leading with findings, financial impact, and required action.
  • Maintain a Product Risk Register, deliver quarterly control maturity updates, and ensure governance bodies are never surprised by a product failure that was visible at the design or portfolio review stage.

Required Knowledge & Skills

Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL for independent data extraction and transaction interrogation
  • Payment systems architecture : Wallets, card processing, direct debit, settlement, and reconciliation
  • API and integration literacy (Basic)
  • End-to-end transaction lifecycle knowledge: Authorisation, posting, clearing, settlement, and exception handling
  • PRD and process flow analysis: translating product documentation into control flowcharts
  • Mathematical precision: fee calculations, interest computations, and split payment structures
  • Pattern recognition: detecting anomalies, outliers, and irregularities in large transaction datasets

Audit & Risk Skills

  • Risk-based audit methodology: IIA Standards and COSO framework applied to financial products.
  • Control design logic and evaluation
  • Root cause analysis
  • Regulatory knowledge: CBN payment system regulations, PCI DSS, NDPR,Nigerian consumer protection obligations etc

Interpersonal & Professional Skills

  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Professional scepticism and independence
  • Risk-rated report writing

Tools & Platforms

  • SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / MSSQL)
  • AdvancedExcel / Google Sheets
  • Claude / AI Tools

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline
  • Experience: 3–5+ years in Product Audit, Systems Audit, Financial Data Analytics, or Payment Operations within a fintech or financial services environment
  • Certifications: CISA, CIA, or CFE preferred. ACA / ACCA is acceptable when combined with strong technical product experience and data analytics.
  • Sector Knowledge: Demonstrated hands-on familiarity with payment product architecture, wallet systems, and regulated payment flows in a Nigerian or comparable market context.

What We Offer You

  • Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’re human, we listen, and we look out for one another.
  • Learning: We’re big on growth. You’ll find an environment focused on knowledge sharing, training, and helping you reach your potential.
  • Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, along with other great benefits.

What to Expect in the Hiring Process

  1. A preliminary phone call with our recruiter.
  2. An interview with the hiring team.
  3. A final conversation with a member of our executive team.

Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer L2 (Messaging Channels).

About the job

This position is needed to power the future of communications by developing the connectivity, compliance and rich messaging features required to enable adoption of new messaging channels and drive continued growth of existing channels such as WhatsApp, RCS and Facebook Messenger. Our team navigates the complexities of requirements across many channels to enable Twilio customers to have a unified and seamless experience. We enable startups, non-profits and Fortune 500 companies to send billions of messages a year on our platform. We are looking for candidates passionate about designing, developing, deploying and operating software solutions at scale to help Twilio deliver the best user experience for modern, rich messaging.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build High-Scale APIs: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance REST APIs and backend microservices using Java and Go.
  • Power Rich Messaging: Build and enhance rich messaging features, managing high-throughput message routing and delivery pipelines.
  • Operate Cloud Systems: Deploy and support backend services in AWS (open to Azure/GCP experience), prioritizing system reliability, low latency, and fault tolerance.
  • Leverage Modern AI Tools: Actively integrate AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) into your daily workflow to accelerate output and elevate code quality.
  • Own System Reliability: Support team on-call rotations to maintain high availability and operational excellence for critical communications services.
  • Collaborate Remotely: Partner asynchronously across distributed engineering teams using clear technical written and verbal communication.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience building backend services in Java or Go
  • Experience designing and building production RESTful APIs as a core part of your day-to-day role
  • Experience operating distributed systems on top of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred, or equivalent experience with Azure/GCP)
  • Hands-on use of AI development tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) to streamline coding, debugging or documentation
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • Ability to participate in on-call rotation (includes weekends and holidays)

Desired:

  • Experience with NoSQL datastores (e.g. DynamoDB)
  • Experience with message queuing (e.g. Simple Queue Service)
  • Experience deploying and supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes
  • Prior experience with telecom or rich messaging platforms (RCS, SMS/MMS, OTT messaging)

Location

This role will be remote and based in the USA

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

[OPTION A: NON OTE ROLES]

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960.00(Developing Minimum for Tier 3) - $175,440.00 (Mid for Tier 3).
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760.00 (Developing Minimum for Tier 2) - $185,640.00 (Mid for Tier 2).
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 (Developing Minimum for Tier 1) - $171,900.00 (Mid for Tier 1).
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs)

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 12/15/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Location(s)

Remote-AZ, Remote-CO, Remote-FL, Remote-GA, Remote-IL, Remote-TX

Details

Kemper Auto is a national provider of car insurance to the high-risk non-standard auto market. Nonstandard insurance serves individuals unable to secure coverage through standard insurance companies. This can be due to a driving record with accidents and/or tickets, prior DUI, the driver's age, vehicle type, or other factors. We pride ourselves as a low-cost auto insurance carrier that you can trust.

As an Inside Sales Executive for Kemper Auto you would be responsible for conducting weekly outbound sales calls and proactive agency communications to increase production in quotes and written premium. The Inside Sales Executive is tasked with engaging a large number of agencies in an assigned State or territory with an objective to meet and exceed annual goals. They work alongside the field sales executive to identify sales opportunities, grow revenue profitably, produce results that meet defined objectives and sales quotas, and act as a brand ambassador to our agents and brokers. Clear and concise communication skills are critical to be successful in this position. Discipline and self-motivation are required to meet sales objectives and goals. This position offers the potential to earn an annual discretionary bonus, determined by your success in the role and company objectives being met.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Develop strong agency relationships; guide, direct and manage agents assigned to you to achieve sales quotas and business objectives. This requires establishing goals and objectives, gaining commitment, persistent follow up, organizational skills, ability to overcome objections, strong sales acumen and critical thinking skills.
  • Execute outbound sales call goals
  • Company representative and liaison between agency and company personnel to identify and resolve issues, which detract from profitable growth and positive company and agency perception.
  • Collaborate and work with the field Sales and Product teams to achieve team goals and agent growth.
  • Drive new agency appointments forward through the defined onboarding process. Participate in and lead training sessions to ensure agency is comfortable with products and guidelines. In partnership with field Sales Executives, manage the agency relationship toward quote adoption and positive production.
  • Participate in regular strategy and tactical meetings with assigned field Sales Executive partners and Inside Sales leadership.
  • As part of your development and duties, occasional field travel and agency visits will be required. You will work in conjunction with your field Sales partner, visiting key relationships.
  • Participate alongside field sales in insurance association conventions, seminars, trade shows, and various other agency related functions.

It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.

But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that. 

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Senior Product Functional Analyst. This full-time, permanent position is based in Poland, with the option to work in a hybrid model from any Vistra office in Poland or fully remotely. The role offers global coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact on our business and its growth.

Vistra is a global leader in corporate services, and we're in the middle of one of the most ambitious transformation programmes in our history. Our purpose is progress: we remove the complexity of global business so our clients can move forward without friction.

At the heart of our operational efficiency is Enate, a powerful workflow management platform that orchestrates and automates key business processes across the organisation. Ensuring the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of this platform requires a proactive support professional who thrives on problem-solving, ownership, and delivering results in a fast-paced global environment.
In this role, you will work closely with business users to help them understand and implement Enate process orchestration across the organisation. Partnering with business process owners, service delivery, project, and technical teams, you will deliver tailored solutions that drive operational efficiency and effectiveness. You will be a critical part of the Business Applications global team within the wider AI & Digital function.

Day to day, you will collaborate with Application Support colleagues, cross-functional technology teams, vendors, and Platform/DevOps teams to investigate issues, resolve incidents, and ensure applications continue to meet business needs.

You will report into the Business Applications, Global organisation and play a key role in maintaining application stability, supporting business operations, and delivering a high standard of customer service.

Key Responsibilities

Contribute to global design of delivery model and corresponding workflow design

Conduct discovery sessions to understand business processes and needs

Work with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system requirements and/or enhancements

Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery and implementation

Develop and present tailored solutions to meet business needs

Assist in planning and execution of project roll outs

Develop and maintain business requirements, solution design and implementation plan documentation

Organize and lead workshops to discuss system standardizations and improvements

Be open to ad-hoc international travel to other Vistra office locations for meetings, workshops or other program related activities

Identify and implement improvements to enhance system efficiency and effectiveness

Effectively communicate and manage progress, updates and risks to senior management and the wider business

Articulate risks, blockers, and dependencies crisply in both written and verbal formats, with actionable recommendations (not just problem statements

Uphold Vistra values by promoting professionalism, collaboration, and customer-centric service delivery

Delivery, Collaboration & Communication

Ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities, and tight deadlines across concurrent projects

Leads requirements gathering workshops and facilitates cross-functional discussions to align business needs with technical solutions

Effective communicator who translates complex business processes into clear functional specifications and documentation

Thrives in a fast-paced, global environment and adapts quickly to shifting priorities and evolving business requirements

This is a career-defining opportunity. You will be at the center of a global transformation program with direct visibility to senior leadership. At Vistra, we offer flexible working arrangements and prioritize the growth of our people.

title: Commercial Counsel
description: At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things!

raw.title: Commercial Counsel
raw.excerpt: At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things!
raw.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose: Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing: Ensono's global Commercial Contracting Office has opened a position for a Corporate Counsel role. This position provides front line support for Ensono's global sales and strategic revenue generating commercial transactions by collaboratively setting deal structure and strategy, performing contract review, drafting and negotiation, coordinating internal approvals and taking overall responsibility for deal completion. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted business advisor to Sales and internal stakeholders, balancing risk management with commercial objectives and developing practical solutions that enable transactions to move forward.

We are looking for a talented attorney with strong business acumen, initiative, drive and experience who can handle a high volume of varied and complex commercial transactions. This position will play a pivotal role in Ensono achieving its strategic and financial objectives by providing consultative, strategic and analytic support services on commercial transactions. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated ability to develop strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders, as well as Ensono's sophisticated enterprise sales or outsourcing customers. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded negotiator who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment and takes ownership of driving transactions to successful outcomes.

What You Will Do

• Lead commercial transactions to closure in prudent and expeditious and solutions-oriented manner

• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex transaction agreements

• Identifying and mitigating issues and risks and ensuring that the business understands risks associated with contract language and positions, while developing practical alternatives that support business objectives

• Provide risk assessment and commercial legal advice, including advice related to relevant laws and regulations

• Exercise judgment and delegated authority on wide-ranging issues

• Coordinate across multiple internal organizations to resolve issues ensure compliance with laws, regulations and company policies

• Vet contract issues/requests with appropriate internal organizations, track responses, and draft resulting feedback

• Prepare and administer escalations as necessary

• Advising on existing contracts, including but not limited to contractual obligations and the resolution of contract disputes, with a focus on achieving commercially reasonable outcomes

• Identify, develop and drive implementation of solutions to deal roadblocks through creative problem-solving, stakeholder alignment and effective negotiation

• Project manage multiple deals to closure simultaneously

• Present training to client groups on transaction legal issues and strategies

• Continuously seek to improve the transaction support process

• Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, Security, Privacy and executive leadership to structure transactions that achieve strategic, operational, and financial objectives.

• Limited travel may be required

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

What You Will Need:

  • Demonstrated success in complex contract review, drafting and negotiation for sales/outsource transactions involving technology products/services.
  • General understanding regarding data privacy laws and regulations and impact on commercial transactions
  • Experience with responsibility for all aspects of commercial transactions, including basic financials and all non-pricing business issues and contract terms
  • Familiarity with all phases of sales/outsource contracting from pre-contract Requests for Proposals/Bids to contract negotiation/execution and post-contract legal support
  • Experience contracting with state and local government clients
  • Successful record of interacting with sophisticated enterprise customers, and their third-party representatives, as transaction counterparties
  • Proven ability to provide entrepreneurial, quick-thinking, pragmatic, business-oriented advice and recommendations in support of revenue-generating transactions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including ability to summarize issues to clients/management
  • Ability to effectively counsel clients concerning legal and business risks in sales transactions while preserving momentum and advancing negotiations toward resolution
  • Ability to work independently with little supervision in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to rapidly assess potential risks, benefits and consequences of business decisions
  • Well-honed project management and organizational skills needed to manage multiple/complex transactions
  • Must be able to prioritize to meet deadlines
  • Independent initiative to develop, lead and implement special projects that enhance contracting processes
  • Strong work ethic and strong sense of responsibility for high quality work product
  • Ability to achieve results under pressure/deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements in a manner that builds credibility with counterparties and facilitates successful deal completion.
  • Strong commercial judgment with the ability to distinguish between material risks and negotiable positions and to recommend practical paths forward.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance legal, operational and financial considerations while supporting business growth and revenue objectives.

Requirements:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school
  • Active bar admission in at least one US jurisdiction
  • 3-5 years of relevant and recent complex commercial transactions experience in an IT Managed Service Provider environment, outsourcing and consulting contract experience required

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $106,000 to $152,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance and an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

Ensono is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment to our Associates and building a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Pay transparency nondiscrimination statement/posting OFCCP’s pay transparency policy can be found on OFCCP’s website.

If you need accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email .

raw.description:
Associate Director, Merchandise Planning

Brilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it. Reporting to the Senior Director of Merchandising, you'll own forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory strategy across every category and function, as well as the roadmap that takes our planning capabilities to the next level. This is a builder's role as much as a planner's: our planning infrastructure is actively evolving, and you'll set the direction, partner with Technology and Merchandising to implement new tools, and raise the analytical bar for the whole team.

You'll build planning approaches that work for attribute-based, specification-driven assortments while holding the line on turn, in-stock, and margin. We have a social and environmental mission at the core of our company, and we're looking for someone excited to deliver exceptional business results while helping us advance it.

What You'll Do:

Inventory Strategy and Forecasting

  • Own sales and inventory forecasts across all categories and functions, and hold the team accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and achievement of inventory plans and KPIs.
  • Set inventory strategy for fine jewelry assortments, including diamond, gemstone, and precious metal commodities, establishing the parameters (weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points) that balance service levels against inventory productivity.
  • Lead inventory planning for new showroom launches and growth initiatives, directing the scenario modeling and statistical analysis that pressure-test those plans.

Open-to-Buy and Financial Planning

  • Own and continue to evolve the OTB alignment and consensus process, translating financial plans into actionable buying strategies with Merchandising and Finance.
  • Contribute to the annual bookings, ASP, and margin budget-setting process, bringing the inventory point of view to category and department targets and reporting consistently against inventory KPIs.

Planning Systems and Process

  • Create and drive the Inventory Planning roadmap. Work with leadership to initiate, prioritize, and approve projects, and manage long-term program schedules through to adoption.
  • Partner with Technology on planning system implementation and maintenance, leading the broader team’s adoption of new demand planning and reporting tools.
  • Adapt planning tools and models to integrate cleanly with our evolving enterprise systems and reporting, identifying gaps, developing workarounds, and replacing them with durable solutions.
  • Leverage AI tools to automate recurring analysis and reporting, and drive identification and rollout of new AI-enabled planning workflows across the function.

Team Leadership and Partnership

  • Manage, coach, and develop a growing planning team through hiring, feedback, and clear team objectives.
  • Raise planning fluency across the organization by mentoring cross-functional Merchandising partners on forecasting and inventory principles, and by representing Planning credibly to executive leadership.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years in merchandise planning, inventory planning, forecasting, or quantitative analysis within retail, product, or e-commerce, including demonstrated success leading and developing a team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification a plus.
  • Experience with attribute-based or commodity inventory planning (precious metals, gemstones, or other specification-driven categories) is a strong plus.
  • Expert Excel skills: complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and efficient handling of large datasets. Retail math is second nature.
  • Hands-on experience with demand planning software (Blue Yonder, Logility, Demantra, o9, MI9, or similar) and reporting/BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Power BI); NetSuite or comparable ERP experience a plus.
  • A track record of leading system implementations and cross-functional programs end to end—from defining business requirements and guiding development through adoption—including new forecasting tools, report automation, and process redesign.
  • Experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Excel Copilot, BI-native AI features, Snowflake Intelligence) to automate analysis and reduce manual effort; familiarity with prompt engineering and connecting AI tools to live data sources such as data warehouses or ERP is highly valued.
  • Comfort operating in an evolving systems environment: you can spot the gap, build the workaround, then turn it into lasting process.
  • Expert written and verbal communication, with clear, direct, concise presentations to broader teams and executive leadership.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter mindset, with the ability to think critically and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to respect and inclusion in the workplace.
  • Interest in socially and environmentally responsible organizations and products.

What We Offer:

  • Career Growth. We want to see you sparkle! Through regular 1-1’s with your manager, a variety of training opportunities, and an annual 360 review process for all employees, our leaders are dedicated to creating clear pathways for growth. Ask the hiring team for more information on how Brilliant Earth creates a culture of collaboration and growth during your interview conversations!
  • Diverse, mission-minded team. We were founded to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. Learn more about our impact and team diversity Here!
  • Lifestyle Spending Account. At Brilliant Earth, we're committed to your well-being. Enjoy company reimbursements for eligible wellness expenses, such as gym memberships, massage, counseling, and more!
  • Continued Education. Company-sponsored learning in leadership, professional skills, diversity & inclusion, and access to tuition reimbursement for role-specific trainings.
  • Employee Discounts. As an employee at Brilliant Earth, you’ll receive a generous discount on our jewelry.
  • Mental Wellness Perks. We offer access to mental health resources, such as self-care apps and seminars. Our Employee Assistance program offers 24/7 access to counseling!
  • Giving Back and Volunteer Opportunities. In addition to our giving back programs, our teams support local initiatives and spend time together by volunteering.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision. We offer multiple plans to choose from, including a $0 monthly premium option for employee health insurance and employer HSA contributions. Insurance kicks in on the first day of your 2nd month!
  • 401k match. We know that saving for the future is important. That's why we offer a generous 401k match.
  • Paid Time Off. We know it’s important to recharge and relax
  • Parental Leave. We aim to support our growing families. Employees can utilize our paid parental leave to bond and care for their new additions.
  • Disability and Life insurance. 100% employer-paid.
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits

More About Us

At Brilliant Earth, our mission is to cultivate a more transparent, sustainable, compassionate, & inclusive jewelry industry. We believe in creating jewelry you can feel good about wearing, without ever compromising between quality and conscience. We are hard-working team players that welcome challenges and rise to any occasion. Our community of collaboration, respect and encouragement is fostered by frequent team events, cross-departmental meetings and celebrating our wins, big and small. As one of the fastest growing e-commerce jewelers in the world, we're searching for bright and passionate people who are excited to make an impact from day one and grow with the company to take on greater responsibility over time.

Brilliant Earth recognizes the value of diversity and inclusion on our team, as we work together to reinvent fine jewelry in a thoughtful and modern way. At Brilliant Earth, we celebrate each other – our successes, the lessons along the way, and the unique perspectives each individual brings to our team. It is our intent to maintain a work environment and hiring process which is free of harassment or discrimination because of sex, race, religion, color, national origin, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, military service, veteran status, or any other status protected by Federal, State or local laws. We are committed to complying with all Federal, State and local laws providing Equal Employment Opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations.

When you apply for a job with Brilliant Earth, we process personal information about you. Please see our Privacy Policy for more information.

raw.title: Senior Director, Marketing
raw.excerpt: Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough.
raw.description:
Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough. Industry-best clinician experiences, better client outcomes, groundbreaking innovation, and access to the highest quality care are how we’ll raise the bar for the entire industry. With that, we're excited and honored to have been recognized as a 2025 Great Place to Work and 2025 Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare.

One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply even if they don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Director of Marketing to lead our Marketing team and drive the strategy and systems that fuel Two Chairs growth.

This leader will oversee Brand and Product Marketing, Commercial Operations, and Integrated Marketing across all of Two Chairs target audiences, with a heavy emphasis on our health plan partners. They will partner closely with Growth, Product, Clinical, Operations and Leadership to distill and communicate our complex value proposition, highlight the benefits of our differentiated clinical model and technology platform, strengthen our payer relationships, accelerate patient demand, and position Two Chairs as the behavioral health provider delivering on superior clinical outcomes.

This is both a strategic leadership role and an operating role. You'll set the long-term vision for Marketing while ensuring the team delivers measurable business impact.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Marketing Strategy & Organizational Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's marketing strategy and organizational structure in support of enterprise growth objectives.
  • Lead and coach a multidisciplinary marketing organization spanning Brand and Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Commercial Operations and Lifecycle, including both full-time team members and contractors.
  • Build organizational capabilities, operating rhythms and processes that enable Marketing to scale alongside the business.
  • Manage marketing budget and prioritization.

Payer Growth & Value-Based Care Narrative

  • Partner with Growth leadership to design and execute marketing strategies that accelerate adoption, expansion, and deep integration within major health plans.
  • Translate complex clinical data, patient outcomes, and value-based care metrics into compelling, insights-driven narratives that resonate with health plan executives and key decision makers..
  • Equip our commercial team with sophisticated enablement materials, competitive insights, ROI calculators, and clinical proof points to shorten payer sales cycles and accelerate adoption and expansion.
  • Identify new growth opportunities through rigorous market insights, competitive intelligence, and cross-functional collaboration.

Brand, Positioning & Corporate Narrative

  • Own company positioning, messaging architecture, and brand strategy.
  • Ensure consistent, differentiated storytelling that bridges the gap between clinical excellence and commercial value.
  • Transform complex, raw clinical research and outcomes into highly compelling, evidence-based value propositions.
  • Protect and strengthen Two Chairs' position as the leader in outcomes-based behavioral healthcare.

Product Marketing, Commercial Enablement & Go-to-Market

  • Lead product positioning, messaging, launches, and commercialization strategies.
  • Partner closely with Product and Clinical teams to bring new capabilities to market.
  • Partner with Research and Clinical leaders to amplify evidence supporting the Two Chairs model.

Insights, Analytics & Operational Excellence

  • Oversee a culture of data-informed decision-making; leverage market research, healthcare trends, and internal clinical data to unearth proprietary insights that drive marketing strategy.
  • Oversee commercial technology, reporting, attribution, CRM strategy, and operational excellence.
  • Build measurement systems that provide visibility into marketing performance across the funnel.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous optimization, and data-informed decision-making.

Impact & Success Indicators

Where you'll make an impact in your first 90 days:

  • Build trusted partnerships across Growth, Product, Clinical, and Operations.
  • Deeply understand the Two Chairs clinical model, data capabilities, and our current value proposition for health plans.
  • Assess the current marketing organization, operating model, and investment priorities.
  • Establish clear success metrics and operating rhythms for the marketing team.
  • Identify the highest-leverage opportunities to accelerate payer, patient, and clinician growth.

Where you'll make an impact in your first year:

  • Establish a robust, insights-driven content and marketing engine that leverages our clinical outcomes to drive market thought leadership.
  • Increase Marketing's measurable contribution to enterprise growth.
  • Strengthen the company's market position and differentiated narrative.
  • Improve commercial enablement and payer engagement.
  • Establish scalable systems for marketing measurement, prioritization, and execution.
  • Develop future marketing capabilities in patient acquisition, lifecycle marketing, and growth.
  • Successfully reposition or sharpen our B2B narrative, resulting in measurable increases in payer engagement and commercial enablement velocity.

We're looking for someone with:

  • 7+ years of marketing leadership experience within the healthcare space, with a proven track record in B2B2C or B2B healthcare marketing (specifically targeting health plans/payers), with behavioral health experience preferred.
  • Deep understanding of value-based care models, healthcare reimbursement, and the behavioral health landscape.
  • A highly analytical and insights-driven mindset; comfortable diving into complex clinical and operational data to extract compelling commercial narratives.
  • Demonstrated success translating complex, technical, or clinical concepts into clear, high-impact marketing collateral and presentations.
  • Extensive experience developing integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable business growth across diverse audiences and channels, with deep expertise spanning Product Marketing, Brand, Lifecycle, and Marketing Operations.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with executive leadership on growth strategy.
  • Experience building, scaling and leading high-performing marketing organizations through periods of rapid growth and change.
  • Excellent executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • A collaborative leadership style and passion for developing teams.

Compensation & Benefits

The offer range is dependent on qualifications and experience. New hires can reasonably expect an offer between $220,000 and $235,000.

Additional perks and benefits:

  • Equity in a high-growth start-up
  • Paid time off, including nine paid holidays and an additional Winter Office Closure from Christmas Day (Observed) through New Year's Day
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement savings options
  • One-time $200 Work from Home reimbursement
  • Annual $1,000 Productivity & Wellness Stipend to support your personal and professional goals
  • Annual $500 subsidized company contribution to your healthcare FSA or HSA
  • Paid parental leave

Outreach Notice to Applicants

We are thrilled that you’re interested in joining our team! To ensure a consistent and equitable hiring process for all candidates, we kindly ask that you refrain from reaching out to current employees regarding the role, your application, or the interview process. Our talent acquisition team is committed to carefully reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if they decide to move forward.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please let your recruiter know so our People Team can assist you.

All applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

raw.description:
About the Job:

As a Staff Engineer on LaunchDarkly's Experimentation team, you'll build the platform that helps engineering teams make data-driven decisions with confidence. Our Experimentation product enables customers to run A/B tests, measure the impact of feature changes, and optimize experiences — integrated with a feature management platform that processes trillions of evaluations daily.

This role sits at the intersection of data science and platform engineering. You'll design the statistical engine, warehouse-native analysis pipelines, and adaptive experimentation systems (including contextual bandits) that power our customers' most important decisions. We want someone who brings genuine depth in applied statistics and ML — as fluent in statistical validity as in system architecture.

You'll also architect warehouse-agnostic features that run analysis directly inside customers' data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery) — modular computation layers that abstract across warehouse environments while maintaining statistical correctness.

Deep technical experience, a scientific mindset, and the ability to influence product and technical direction are critical. You'll lead by example: setting the bar for rigor, mentoring teammates, and owning systems end to end, including on-call.

Responsibilities:

  • Build the experimentation statistical engine — hypothesis testing, sequential analysis, variance reduction (CUPED, Winsorization), power analysis. Ensure statistical correctness across all experiment types.

  • Design warehouse-native experimentation that runs analysis inside customer warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery). Build modular, warehouse-agnostic abstractions for rapid new backend support.

  • Lead adaptive experimentation — contextual bandit systems, Bayesian optimization, automated allocation beyond simple A/B tests.

  • Drive the platform roadmap with product, design, and data science. Shape what we build, not just how.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Warehouse Integrations, SDK, Platform, and Data Science teams.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the team's bar for statistical rigor and system design.

  • Own operational excellence — monitoring, observability, incident response, on-call. Robust telemetry and alerting.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years building large-scale experimentation platforms, statistical analysis systems, or data-intensive backend services.

  • Applied-statistics knowledge: hypothesis testing, sequential analysis, variance reduction (CUPED), power analysis, experiment design. Comfortable with frequentist vs. Bayesian trade-offs.

  • Experience with adaptive experimentation ML — contextual bandits, Thompson sampling, Bayesian optimization, or RL-based allocation.

  • Track record designing warehouse-agnostic systems across Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar.

  • Expertise in Go, Python, or similar for backend services and statistical computation.

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and large-scale data processing.

  • Cloud environments (AWS, GCP) with infrastructure-as-code.

  • Technical leadership: setting direction, breaking down complex problems, influencing across teams.

  • Ability to translate statistical concepts for product and engineering audiences.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 5:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $214,800 - $295,350*
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $193,400 - $265,870**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $182,600 - $251,0202**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at .

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @ email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to .
