raw.title: Senior Content Designer
raw.excerpt: Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry.
raw.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry.

Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it’s porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners’ internal teams.

We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

  • 2K
  • Xbox
  • Meta
  • Obsidian Entertainment
  • Turtle Rock Studios
  • Gearbox Software

At Devoted Studios, we’re committed to making outsourcing more efficient, collaborative, and impactful. If you're passionate about co-development, game art, or solving technical challenges on a global scale.

We are looking for a Senior Content Designer to shape the story-driven chapter content that carries players through a live game. This role sits outside core gameplay. You will own the world players journey through between play sessions: the environments they restore and unlock, the characters they meet, the narrative beats that frame their progress, and the special moments that make each milestone feel earned.

You will be the connective tissue between narrative, environment, characters, and animation. Working alongside writers, artists, animators, and producers, you will turn chapter concepts into cohesive, buildable experiences and keep the creative intent intact from first pitch through final polish, all within the guidelines of an established IP and a collaborative partner review process.

Responsibilities

  • Conceive and pitch chapter concepts, defining the setting, story arc, characters, and the sequence of environments and moments players unlock as they progress.
  • Design the environments players move through, including layout, points of interest, and how each space visibly transforms as players advance.
  • Shape narrative beats, character arcs, and dialogue moments in partnership with writers, so that story and progression reinforce each other.
  • Design signature moments such as reveals, transformations, celebrations, and chapter finales that reward progress and deliver emotional payoff.
  • Serve as the bridge between design, art, and animation, translating creative intent into clear direction that each discipline can execute against.
  • Define character staging, animation needs, and camera framing for key beats, balancing creative ambition against animation scope and production cost.
  • Own chapter documentation, including one-pagers, beat sheets, environment briefs, asset lists, and moment breakdowns.
  • Guide chapters through phased reviews, from early feasibility and blockout through concept, implementation, and polish.
  • Partner with client stakeholders, internal discipline leads, and production to align on scope, milestones, and quality, presenting work and incorporating feedback with clarity.
  • Maintain consistency of tone, lore, and visual language across chapters, and avoid creating story or content dependencies that constrain future chapters.
  • Review implemented content in build, identifying issues with pacing, readability, and staging, and driving fixes with the team.
  • Identify creative and production risks early and propose practical alternatives that protect quality and schedule.
  • Contribute to content pipelines, templates, and best practices that make chapter production faster and more repeatable.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of game development experience in content, narrative, level, or world design, with at least 2 years in a senior role.
  • At least one shipped commercial title where you owned player-facing story, environment, or content design.
  • A portfolio that shows environments, narrative beats, and player moments you designed and carried through to release.
  • Strong understanding of how story, environment, characters, and animation work together to communicate progression and reward.
  • Strong visual communication skills, with the ability to express ideas through sketches, paintovers, mood boards, storyboards, or blockouts.
  • Working knowledge of art and animation pipelines, with a practical sense of what is costly to build and how to scope accordingly.
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to write clear briefs and pitch ideas confidently to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working within an established IP, brand guidelines, or licensor approval process.
  • Experience collaborating directly with external partners or clients, with confidence managing feedback, expectations, and shifting priorities.
  • A strong sense of pacing, tone, and player empathy, with an instinct for moments that land emotionally.
  • Based in Europe or the UK, with fluent written and spoken English.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience on mobile, casual, or live-service games with a narrative or meta-progression layer.
  • A background in environment art, level art, or narrative writing alongside design.
  • Experience designing for broad, all-ages audiences.
  • Familiarity with in-game cameras, cinematic staging, or lightweight cutscene tools.
  • Experience with proprietary engines and content tools, or with Unity or Unreal for blockouts and prototyping.
  • Comfort working in co-development environments with embedded teams.

Benefits

Why Join Us?

We offer:

  • Work on ambitious games with top-tier partners across genres and platforms.
  • Join a remote-first team spanning 15+ countries.
  • Competitive compensation, project bonuses, and growth opportunities.
  • Be part of a studio that values craft, collaboration, and long-term partnership.

This is a remote, full-time contracted position.

We are an equal opportunity company and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contract without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Description

Salary: $51,000 plus the eligibility of a performance bonus


Start Date: School Year 2026/2027

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.


Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Carolus Online Academy (COA). We want you to be a part of our talented team!


The mission of Carolus Online Academy (COA) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!


The Elementary School Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. Elementary School Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Elementary School Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Elementary School Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.


This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Provides rich and engaging synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences for students
  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students
  • Demonstrates a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations
  • Differentiates instruction based on student level of mastery
  • Augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools under guidance from principal and coach
  • Maintains grade book ensuring student academic integrity, makes student placement and promotion decisions, and alerts administrators to concerns about student performance and progress
  • Prepares students for high stakes standardized tests
  • Understands that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner
  • Supports learning coaches/parents with student curricular and instructional issues, as well as basic troubleshooting in a virtual classroom environment that is in line with academy policies and procedures
  • Travels as required (on average once per month and/or approximately 20% of the time) for face-to-face professional development, student testing, and as required by school

REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree AND
  • Active state teaching license AND
  • Ability to clear required background check

DESIRED QUALIFICATION:

  • Experience working with proposed age group.
  • Experience supporting adults and children in the use of technology.
  • Experience teaching in an online (virtual) and/or in a brick-and-mortar environment.
  • Experience with online learning platforms.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with other teachers to interpret and produce numeric, tabular, and graphic representations of student data, and use it to drive instructional decisions.
  • Receptive to receiving coaching regularly with administrators and teacher trainers.
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint.
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms.
  • Ability to maintain teacher certification/professional development hours and fluency in K12 systems, programs and curriculum.

Salaries will differ based on these factors, the position’s level and expected contribution, and the employee’s benefits elections. Offers will typically be in the bottom half of the range.

raw.description:
Join us, be part of more.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that's energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion, and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently - we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it, and mend it.

About your team:

At British Gas, our mission is to sell it and mend it.

We’ve been powering the UK’s homes and businesses for over 200 years – but supplying energy is just part of what we do. We’re making the UK greener and more energy efficient, getting closer to Net Zero. By using clever tech like thermostats, heat pumps, solar panels and EV chargers, we’re making it cheaper and easier for our customers to reduce their carbon-footprint.

As a Revenue Protection Performance Manager you will lead the development and continuous improvement of our approach to energy theft detection and Revenue Protection field performance.

You will use operational, commercial and industry insight to improve conversion, efficiency and field effectiveness, ensuring Revenue Protection activity delivers strong customer, regulatory and commercial outcomes.

Through expert leadership, collaboration and constructive challenge, you will strengthen Revenue Protection capability, embed best practice and help drive the organisation towards industry-leading performance.


Location:

Flexible/Homebased


Accountabilities:


  • Lead the continuous improvement of Revenue Protection investigation and detection performance.
  • Develop and implement approaches that improve theft detection conversion, field efficiency and commercial outcomes whilst maintaining customer, safety and regulatory standards.
  • Use operational, commercial and performance data to identify opportunities, understand performance drivers and translate insight into practical field improvements.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators across the end-to-end Revenue Protection process, ensuring performance is understood and improvement activity is focused in the right areas.
  • Act as a Revenue Protection subject matter expert, strengthening organisational knowledge and supporting operational teams in making effective investigation and field decisions.
  • Develop and embed Revenue Protection best practice, ensuring field colleagues have the knowledge, processes and tools required to maximise detection effectiveness.
  • Identify capability and knowledge gaps and work with operational leaders to develop sustainable solutions that improve Revenue Protection expertise.
  • Build external industry relationships to understand emerging practice, benchmark performance and identify opportunities to strengthen our approach.
  • Drive performance against relevant industry incentive arrangements and support the ambition to achieve industry-leading performance.
  • Work collaboratively with operational teams to improve conversion, productivity and efficiency while ensuring activity remains commercially effective.
  • Identify and challenge existing practices where opportunities exist to improve customer, operational or commercial outcomes.
  • Drive effective use of systems, technology and data to improve decision-making, field effectiveness and performance visibility.
  • Support the development and implementation of changes to processes, systems and ways of working that improve Revenue Protection performance.

Key Stakeholders and Working Relationships


  • Build strong relationships across Revenue Protection, field operations, performance, commercial and supporting business teams to identify opportunities and remove barriers to improved performance.
  • Develop effective relationships with industry partners, service providers and external stakeholders to share best practice, strengthen organisational knowledge and support industry-leading Revenue Protection delivery.

Work Experience & Functional/Technical Skills:


  • Strong operational knowledge and experience of Revenue Protection, energy theft investigation or a comparable specialist field environment.
  • Strong understanding of Revenue Protection investigation and detection practices and the factors that influence successful field outcomes.
  • Ability to interpret operational and commercial performance data and translate insight into practical improvement activity.
  • Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance detection performance, efficiency, cost, customer and regulatory considerations.
  • Experience of developing and embedding operational best practice and driving continuous improvement.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability, with the confidence to constructively challenge established ways of working.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with operational teams, senior leaders, industry stakeholders and external partners.
  • Confidence using business systems, digital tools and performance reporting to identify opportunities and drive improvement.
  • Ability to operate as a subject matter expert, strengthening organisational capability and sharing specialist knowledge across the business.

Why should you apply?

We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.

If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

raw.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

A UK-based company is hiring a skilled Backend.NET Developer to join our team and play a key role in delivering a high-impact project. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Microsoft technologies, excellent problem-solving skills, and experience integrating complex back-end functionality with front-end systems.

You will work closely with the Head of Development and collaborate with a front-end developer to bring this project to life. A functional specification and project requirements will be provided, but you will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions that meet business needs.

Responsibilities :-

  • Integrate front-end components into Umbraco CMS

  • Build and customize back-office editors for modules

  • Enhance back-office UX to ensure ease of use for content editors

  • Create templates, configuration options, and theming capabilities for components

  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and handle third-party integrations (e.g., CRMs, payment gateways, marketing tools)

  • Implement job search functionality within the system

  • Ensure high-quality code through unit testing and browser testing

  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security

  • Collaborate in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver features iteratively


    • Requirements

    • Umbraco CMS (v8/9/10+): custom development, templates, back-office extensions; familiarity with Umbraco APIs, content models, and package integration

    • Microsoft .NET & C#: ASP.NET Core / .NET Framework, C#, Razor, Visual Studio; strong LINQ skills

    • Database: Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, query optimization

    • APIs & Security: building/consuming RESTful APIs; OAuth/JWT/IdentityServer for auth

    • Source Control & Delivery: Git (Beanstalk/SmartGit or equivalent), CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), IIS config & URL rewrite

    • Engineering Foundations: MVC architecture; design patterns (DI, Repository, SOLID); performance optimization, caching, and security best practices

    • Collaboration & Delivery: clear communication, strong debugging/problem-solving, ability to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions; Agile/Scrum experience

    Preferred

    • Deploying Umbraco on Azure (App Services, SQL, Blob Storage)

    • Front-end familiarity (JavaScript/React/Vue) for smoother collaboration

    • Experience with headless CMS (Umbraco Heartcore)

    • SEO and accessibility best practices


    Benefits

  • Professional growth opportunities with access to training and certifications

  • Collaborative and innovative team culture with direct impact on projects

    • Work with a forward-thinking UK-based company in the employer marketing space

Pay Range:

$51.05 - $76.60

Join Us in Redefining Care


At Advocate Health, we're committed to helping people live well by delivering exceptional care with compassion, innovation, and expertise. We're seeking an experienced Culture & Teammate Experience Operations Manager to help turn teammate experience data into meaningful strategies, tools, and enterprise-wide solutions.


In this role, you'll partner across the organization to strengthen engagement, support large-scale change, and equip leaders with actionable insights that improve the teammate experience at the enterprise, region, and market levels.


About This Opportunity

This opportunity is ideal for a strategic, analytical leader who can connect complex data, organizational trends, and teammate feedback to practical recommendations. You will lead cross-functional work, advance teammate survey processes, and present experience insights that inform leadership strategy and forecasting.


What You'll Do

  • Develop quantitative and qualitative analytical strategies to measure the effectiveness of teammate experience programs, interventions, and enterprise-wide efforts.
  • Use data to identify targeted teammate experience interventions at the enterprise, region, and market levels.
  • Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence to design best-in-class tools and resources that help leaders improve teammate experience.
  • Support large-scale change initiatives across the enterprise focused on improving teammate experience.
  • Lead cross-functional teams in designing new engagement solutions.
  • Analyze organizational and market trends to develop and implement solutions that strengthen teammate experience.
  • Combine information from multiple data sources to generate insights and create effective presentations.
  • • Refine and present experience insights to inform leadership strategy and forecasting.
  • Demonstrate leadership presence and inspire collaboration across all levels of the organization.
  • Provide reporting and presentations to leadership teams.
  • Coordinate, facilitate, and continuously strengthen teammate survey methodology and processes.

What You'll Bring

  • Master's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, or a related field
  • Typically five years of related experience
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor, interpret, and identify trends
  • Excellent presentation skills and demonstrated ability to communicate analytical data and metrics clearly
  • Working knowledge of HR technology, data analytics programs, and tools
  • Strong customer service orientation
  • Outstanding interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Self-directed work style with excellent time management and attention to detail
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite
  • Proven track record of achieving goals in a timely and collaborative manner.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of healthcare principles and the operations of an acute care hospital

This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.


Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

  • Defined contribution retirement plans with employer match and other financial wellness programs

  • Educational Assistance Program

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly motivated Cybersecurity Specialist to join our IT security team. In this role, you will be responsible for protecting our organization's digital infrastructure and sensitive information from internal and external threats. You will work closely with IT, development, compliance, and risk management teams to ensure the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of our systems and data.

Duties

  • Monitor networks and systems for security breaches, incidents, and vulnerabilities.

  • Implement and maintain firewalls, encryption, and other security measures.

  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing.

  • Respond to and investigate security incidents, providing detailed reports and mitigation strategies.

  • Maintain and update security policies, protocols, and procedures in compliance with industry standards.

  • Provide training and guidance to employees on cybersecurity awareness and best practices.

  • Collaborate with third-party vendors and consultants on security audits and assessments.

  • Ensure systems and software are updated with the latest security patches and fixes.

  • Assist in disaster recovery planning and business continuity efforts.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

  • Proven experience in a cybersecurity role or related IT security field.

  • Strong knowledge of security frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001) and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Proficiency in security tools such as SIEMs, firewalls, IDS/IPS, antivirus, and endpoint protection platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) is a plus.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, or CISM preferred.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Retirement plan options (401(k) or equivalent).

  • Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays.

  • Flexible work schedule and remote work opportunities.
